Solid-state imaging element and its manufacturing method
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To contrive the reduction of a driving voltage in the horizontal charge transfer path and the improvement of an operating frequency of a solid-state imaging element.  <P>SOLUTION: The solid-state imaging element is provided with a plurality of photoelectric conversion units arranged on a semiconductor substrate in a two-dimensional state, a vertical charge transfer unit for receiving a signal charge generated in the photoelectric conversion unit and transferring the charge into vertical direction, and a horizontal charge transfer unit for receiving the signal charge transferred by the vertical charge transfer unit and transferring the same into horizontal direction. Charge transferring electrodes which constitute the horizontal charge transfer path are arrayed through an insulating film between electrodes, while the insulating films between electrodes are arrayed and formed so that the thickness thereof becomes thinner alternately between neighboring charge transfer electrodes.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Solid-state image sensor, its manufacturing method and imaging device
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a solid-state image sensor capable of improving sensitivity and charge transfer efficiency by improving an aperture ratio of a photoelectric conversion portion, and to provide a manufacturing method of the element and imaging device.  <P>SOLUTION: A pixel portion 11 wherein a plurality of photoelectric conversion elements 10 generating signal charges by sensing light are arranged in matrix, and a vertical charge transfer portion 12 which reads out the signal charges generated by photoelectric conversion elements 10 to transfer, are formed on a semiconductor substrate surface layer. The charge transfer portion 12 has a plurality of first transfer electrodes for transferring the signal charges and a plurality of second transfer electrodes provided among the first transfer electrodes. An anti-reflective film is extended over a region of the semiconductor substrate where the photoelectric conversion elements 10 is formed and at least a part of a region of the semiconductor substrate below the second transfer electrode of a semiconductor substrate.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: High definition still picture camera system
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To scan and read a picture element signal at a high speed, without effect of offset and high resolution by increasing number of vertical picture elements and cancelling the offset with respect to the picture element signal read from a horizontal charge transfer line. CONSTITUTION:A control means controlling drive signals phiA1, phiB1, phiA2, phiB2, phi2, phi4 is provided and an offset cancellation means cancelling of an offset of each horizontal charge transfer line included in each picture element signal outputted from 1st and 2nd horizontal charge transfer lines HCCD1, HCCD2 is provided to the system. Number of vertical picture elements is increased and a picture element signal generated in a photodiode is transferred by 2 field each synchronously with the drive signal of 6-phase drive and scanned and read simultaneously via two horizontal charge transfer lines. Moreover, the offset with respect to each picture element signal read from each horizontal charge transfer line is cancelled to attain scanning and readout of the picture element signal at high speed without effect of the offset and with high resolution.

docs.title: Image sensor
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce time delay generated at the time of shifting a mode from an idle read mode to a light receiving mode, by providing a control means which supplies electric charge accumulated in a prescribed capacitive element to the coupling capacitor of a photoelectric transducer when at least two or more vertical scanning lines are scanned simultaneously. CONSTITUTION:Capacitors C1...Cm are connected to one ends of signal read lines l1...lm via MOS switches Tc1...Tcm, and the switches Tc1...Tcm are connected to the output terminals of a control circuit 3 via a reset signal line LRS, and their ON and OFF operations are controlled by a reset signal SRS outputted from the control circuit 3. And a circuit is constituted so that a start pulse CK1 to be supplied to a vertical scanning register 1 is inputted via an OR circuit 4, and to the input terminal on the other side of the OR circuit 4, for example, a control signal EN being generated by the shutter release button of a camera is supplied, and the signal EN is also supplied to the control circuit 3. Therefore, it is possible to shift the mode to the light receiving mode from a time when the generation of the final vertical scanning signal line Svn based on the pulse CK-1 is completed, consequently, to set the mode at the light receiving mode earlier than ever. Also, since the capacitive element is formed outside a light receiving area, the high density and high integration of a picture element can be realized.

docs.title: Solid-state imaging element and imaging device
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To restrain transfer efficiency deterioration of a charge transfer path of an element central part even in a solid-state imaging element wherein multiple pixels are realized.  <P>SOLUTION: A solid-state imaging element includes a plurality of pixels 101 which are formed and disposed in two dimensional array on a surface part of a semiconductor substrate, and a plurality of charge transfer paths 102 which are formed along each of a plurality of pixel lines constituted of the pixel 101. A charge transfer path 102b formed in a center of a surface part of a charge transfer path is formed wider when compared with a charge transfer path 102a formed in an end side which is in a direction perpendicular to a transfer direction of a charge transfer path.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Solid-state imaging apparatus and drive method of solid-state image sensor
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a solid-state imaging apparatus capable of reducing the power consumption in the case of sweeping out smear electric charges at a high speed.  <P>SOLUTION: The solid-state imaging apparatus comprises: a solid-state image sensor including a well formed in a semiconductor substrate, electric charge storage regions arranged in the well in a matrix form and storing signal electric charges obtained by photoelectric conversion to an incident light, a plurality of vertical transfer channels formed close to each column of the electric charge storage regions to be extended in the columnar direction as a whole, vertical transmission electrodes formed above them, reading the signal electric charges stored in the electric charge storage regions to the vertical transfer channels, transferring produced smear electric charges in the columnar direction, and transferring the electric charges transferred from the vertical transfer channels in the horizontal direction; and a drive section that outputs two voltages with a first difference when transferring the signal electric charges read from the electric charge storage regions to the vertical transfer electrodes and outputs two voltages with a second difference smaller than the first difference when transferring the smear electric charges.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: Imaging apparatus, solid-state imaging element, and method of driving solid-state imaging element
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an imaging apparatus capable of correctly reading a signal even when the transfer capacitance of a vertical charge transfer path is small and insufficient with respect to the saturation capacitance of a photoelectric conversion element due to micro-fabrication.  <P>SOLUTION: When a plurality of photoelectric conversion elements 51 and a plurality of vertical charge transfer paths 52 pay attention to a certain photoelectric conversion element 51, an imaging element driving part 10 for driving a solid-state imaging element 5 disposed on a semiconductor substrate 50 so as to arrange two vertical charge transfer paths 52 side by side horizontally at a side of the photoelectric conversion element 51 with the attention paid thereto drives the solid-state imaging element 5 in a first driving mode for using the two vertical charge transfer paths located at the side of the photoelectric conversion element 51 to transfer charge occurring in the photoelectric conversion element 51 and in a second driving mode for using a vertical charge transfer path 52 adjacent to the photoelectric conversion element 51 between the two vertical charge transfer paths 52 located at the side of the photoelectric conversion element 51 to transfer the charge occurring in the photoelectric conversion element 51.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Solid-state image pickup element
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To substantially compress the number of picture elements capable of displaying by an ordinary TV picture tube from a solid-state image pickup device having more picture elements than a standard type to take out a picture signal by outputting output terminals of respective steps of a shift register constituted by logically connected logical elements by gathering plural steps. CONSTITUTION:One line vertical switch 5 corresponding to one respective scanning line is controlled by the outputs at respective steps of a vertical shift register 4, and respective horizontal switches 3 are controlled by outputs of the respective steps of a horizontal shift register 2. The respective output terminals of the respective steps of these shift registers 2, 4 are gathered as a pair every two adjacent steps or two steps of every other step and the output terminals of these two steps are connected by a logical element. For instance, when the respectively adjacent two output terminals of the horizontal shift register 2 are connected, a high level signal is supplied to a line b and a low level signal to a line a. In this case, when on the i+1st step of the horizontal shift register 2, the signal 1 is present, the picture signals of the ith step and the i+1st step are read.

docs.title: Photographic film cartridge and camera
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a photographic film cartridge where the inadvertent rotation of a spool is prevented. CONSTITUTION:By rotating the spool 4, the leading edge of photographic film 5 is fed from a film entrance 17. A lock means for locking the rotation of the spool 4 is incorporated on the other end face 15 side opposed to one end face 13 of the cartridge main body 3 positioned in a direction where the cartridge is loaded in the cartridge loading chamber of a camera with respect to the axial direction of the spool 4. A hole 12 piereced by a releasing pin provided on a cover closing the cartridge loading chamber of a camera is provided on the other end face 15 of the cartridge main body 3. When the cover is closed after loading the photographic film cartridge in the cartridge loading chamber, the releasing pin gets into the hole 12 and the lock means is moved so as to release the locking of the rotation of the spool 4.

docs.title: Photographic film cartridge and camera
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To inexpensively provide a camera and a photographic film cartridge which can be accurately positioned in the cartridge loading chamber of the camera. CONSTITUTION:By rotating a spool 4, the leading edge of photographic film is fed. 1st and 2nd engaging holes are formed on one end face of a cartridge main body 3, and positioning pins 19 and 20 provided on an inner wall 17 for positioning on a camera 15 side are fitted in the engaging holes to position the photographic film cartridge 2. An observation window 28 through which display that the kind of the photographic film is recorded on the seal 22 of the cartridge main body 3 is observed and a light shielding sponge 35 which shields light advancing from the window 28 into the cartridge loading chamber 16 are provided on the bottom cover 29 which closes the chamber 16. The spong 35 presses the cartridge main body 3 toward the inner wall 17 at the time of closing the bottom cover 29.

docs.title: Converter lens built-in type video camera
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To smoothly shift a usual zooming operation to an ultra-variable power operation by using a zooming operation part used for the usual zooming operation such as a seesaw knob also as an operation part for switching to ultra-variable power. CONSTITUTION:A zoom lens 13 incorporates a converter lens 44. The converter lens 44 gets a position where it is retreated from an optical axis 7 and a posi tion where it is inserted on the optical axis 7 by actuating an attaching and detaching device 48 utilizing a motor and a solenoid, etc. By moving a variable power lens 17 in a state where the converter lens 44 is retreated, the variable power is performed within a usual zoom range. By inserting the converter lens 44, the zoom lens 13 becomes in an ultra-wide angle state which is not obtained in the usual zoom range. In such a state, the variable power lens 17 is moved by operating the seesaw knob 14 to perform the zooming operation in an optional direction.

docs.title: Zoom lens device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To accurately switch focusing in a normal zoom area and focusing in super-wide-angle mode by performing focusing operation by rotating a zoom ring in a macrophotography area in response to the ON signal of a switch when a wide converter lens is inserted into an optical system. CONSTITUTION:When the insertion of the wide converter lens 35 into the optical system is detected by the signal from a microswitch 50, the focusing is performed by the rotation of the zoom ring, but the rotation range of the zoom ring is limited to only the macrophotography area. Therefore, when the microswitch 50 is turned on while the zoom ring is in the normal zoom area, a focus controller 47 puts a zoom motor driving circuit 48 to rotate the zoom ring forcibly to the macrophotography area. Consequently, zoom ring forcibly to the macrophotography area. Consequently, the focusing mechanism for the macrophotography area can be utilized for the focusing in super-wide-angle mode and the focusing is automated even at this time.

docs.title: Camera
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a take-out mechanism whose constitution is simple, which does not require much set space, and by which a loaded film cartridge is extremely easily taken out in a camera equipped with a housing chamber extended from a loading port formed on the surface part of a camera main body toward the inside of the camera main body. CONSTITUTION:A lift member 32 extended in the loading direction of the film cartridge 10 is provided so as to move back and forth in the loading direction in the housing chamber 23. The lift member 32 is energized upward by a tension spring 33. When the member 32 rises, it abuts on the cartridge 10 from below and lifts the cartridge 10 to a position where it can be taken out. The member 32 which has risen is pushed down in the case of loading the cartridge 10, and locked by a locking member 34. By closing a bottom cover 24, the member 32 is pressed by a projected part 25 and moves downward further. At this time, the locking of the member 32 by the locking member 34 is released.

docs.title: Shutter device for consecutive photographing
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an exposure speed which is sufficiently quicker than an exposure interval without using an expensive stepping motor. CONSTITUTION:When a traveling plate 12 is made to travel, elliptic gears 14 and 16 are rotated through a rack gear 12a, a gear 13 and a sub-gear 15. Besides, shutter plates 10 and 11 are rotated through a sub-gear 17 by cyclically changing the speed thereof. Slits 28 and 29 successively cross exposure apertures 6a-6d when the plates 10 and 11 are rotated at a high speed and consecutive photographing pictures 42a-42d are photographed by precise exposure.

docs.title: Photographic printing device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To perform continuous photographic printing operation without damaging a negative film which is not linked in a roll shape by providing a storage means for storing the negative film, a negative film conveying means, a negative carrier part, a frame feeding means, an image information detecting means, and a conveyance and frame feeding control means. CONSTITUTION:A suctional conveying means 36 moves a sucker 38 through the driving of a motor 70 and the sucker 38 abuts on the reverse surface of the lowermost negative film 14A. When a moving table 48 moves along a long guide hole 56, the sucker 38 lowers the hold part of the negative film 14A, so a gap is formed between said film and a next negative film 14A. Consequently, even when the lowermost negative film 14A is drawn out lengthwise by the suctional conveying means 36, the friction against the next negative film 14 is extremely small and, specially, the breadth-wise center part where an image is formed is bent and separate from the next negative film 14, so they are hardly damaged.

docs.title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material and production thereof
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the photosensitive material which is excellent in sharpness, causes less coating troubles at the time of production and has excellent latent image preservable stability by providing at least one layer of specific silver halide emulsion layers on a base. CONSTITUTION:At least one layer of the silver halide emulsion layers are pro vided on the base. The layers are obtd. by mixing a dispersion contg. the cyan coupler expressed by formula I and contg. the high boiling org. solvent coexisiting therewith at <=0.3 by the weight of the cyan coupler and a color sensitized silver halide emulsion, then applying the mixture on the base for over 20 minutes without stagnating the liquid. In the formula, R1 denotes a halogen atom, aliphat. group, etc.; l ' denotes 0 to 3 integer; R3 denotes a hydro gen atom or R6U; T denotes a hydrogen atom or the group which can be elimi nated by the coupling reaction with the oxidant of an arom. primary amine developing agent. The photosensitive material which is excellent in the sharp ness, causes the less coating troubles at the time of production and has the excellent latent image preservable stability is obtd. in this way.

In the formulae I-III, R<1> is -(CH2)r-CONHSO2-R<3>-(CH2)s or the like; and each of R<3>-R<6> is an alkyl or the like; each of X<1> and X<2> is an alkyl, aryl or a heterocyclic group or the like: and X<3> forms a heterocyclic group or the like together with >N-.

docs.title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain excellent color reproduction performance and storage stability and pressure resistance by incorporating tri- and mono-methine cyanine dyes in at leant one of green-sensitive silver halide emulsion layers. CONSTITUTION:All the red-sensitive silver halide emulsion layers have the gravity center photosensitive wavelength (lambda-R) of >500nm and <=580nm in the spectral sensitivity distribution of interimage effects given from other layers in the range of 500nm-600nm, and all the green-sensitive silver halide emulsion layers have that (lambdaC) of >520nm and <=580nm, and lambdaC-lambda-R>=10nm. Such a silver halide color photographic sensitive material contains the tri- and mono- methine cyanine dyes in at least one of the green-sensitive silver halide emulsion layers, thus permitting the obtained silver halide color photographic sensitive material to be excellent in color reproduction performance and improved in storage stability in high temperature and high humidity and moreover enhanced in pressure resistance.

docs.title: Silver halide photographic sensitive material and recording method using same
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To enhance sensitivity and storage stability of a latent image while maintaining high resolution by forming an emulsion layer having silver halide emulsion controlled to produce an ultrafine grain emulsion by specified method and incorporating a specified compound in the emulsion layer. CONSTITUTION:At least one of photosensitive silver halide emulsion layers formed on a support has at least one of the emulsions controlled so as to contain ultrafine silver halide grains having an average grain diameter of <=0.05mum produced in the presence of a substance to be adsorbed to a polymer compound having a physical restraint degree of >=40 or silver halide during or after forming the grains in the ultrafine silver halide emulsion. At least one of the compounds represented by formula I and the like is contained. In formula I comprising general formulae OMEGAA and OMEGAB, X<101> is O, S, =NH; X<102> is S; each of R<101> and R<102> is H, alkyl, aryl, or a heterocyclic group; R<103> is H or lower alkyl; R<104> is H, alkyl, aryl, or vinylmethyl: and n101 is 0 or 1.

docs.title: Heat developable photosensitive material
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a heat developable photosensitive material which ensures little unevenness in reflected gloss and little cissing failure for the non-photosensitive back side.  <P>SOLUTION: The heat developable photosensitive material includes, on one side of a support, an image forming layer containing at least a photosensitive silver halide, a non-photosensitive organic silver salt, a reducing agent and a binder, and, on the other side of the support, a non-photosensitive back side layer. The total quantity of an alkaline earth metal contained in the non-photosensitive back side layer is 1×10<SP>-5</SP>-1×10<SP>-3</SP>mol/m<SP>2</SP>.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

docs.title: シート体用搬送装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】幅寸法の異なる種々のシート体を、損傷させる ことなく円滑に搬送するとともに、構成の簡素化を図る ことを可能にする。
【解決手段】ガイド機構７２は、蓄積性蛍光体シートＳ の搬送方向に交差する幅方向に延在する軸部材８２と、 前記蓄積性蛍光体シートＳに接触するとともに、前記軸 部材８２に対して軸方向に移動可能に設けられる第１お よび第２可動ローラ部材８４ａ、８４ｂと、該蓄積性蛍 光体シートＳの幅寸法に応じて、前記第１および第２可 動ローラ部材８４ａ、８４ｂを前記軸方向に移動させる 駆動機構８６とを備える。

docs.title: シート体搬送機構
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】寸法の異なる種々のシート体を片側基準で高精 度に搬送するとともに、構成を有効に簡素化することを 可能にする。
【解決手段】シート体搬送機構１０は、蓄積性蛍光体シ ート３２を挟持して搬送するローラ対９０を備えるとと もに、このローラ対９０の左右のニップ圧がそれぞれ異 なる値に設定されている。このため、寸法の異なる蓄積 性蛍光体シート３２に作用するニップ圧が、該蓄積性蛍 光体シート３２の左右で不均一になることがなく、高精 度な搬送処理が遂行される。

docs.title: シート搬送装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】ジャムしたシートの確認を確実にでき、しかも 確実にジャム処理を行うことができるシート搬送装置を 提供する。
【解決手段】内側扉部３および外側扉部４を有する二重 扉構造の開閉扉２を備え、この開閉扉２と装置本体１と の間に第１のシート搬送路５を設けると共に、前記内側 扉部３と外側扉部４の間に第２のシート搬送路６を設け てなるシート搬送装置であって、開閉扉２の開放時に、 自動的に内側扉部３と外側扉部４とが離間せしめられる 間隔作成手段７ａを設ける。更に、両扉部の開放間隔が 調整せしめられる間隔調整手段７ｂを設ける。また、内 側扉部３と外側扉部４間のロック解除手段８を複数箇所 に設け、いずれのロック解除手段８によってもロックを 解除可能に構成する。さらに、ロック解除手段８の操作 部８ａの設置方向を表示する表示部９を設ける。

docs.title: 多軸ターレット式ウエブ巻取装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】装置の大型化を抑制しながら、合わせて巻取ロ ールの大径化や広幅化に対応することができる。
【解決手段】作業床７０上に対向する支持フレーム７ ６、７７に、面板７２、７３の外周部を旋回軸受７４、 ７５を介して支持する面板支持機構、作業床７０下に配 設されて前記面板支持機構の面板７２、７３を回転駆動 する面板駆動部、面板支持機構の面板７２、７３に面板 駆動部からの動力を伝達する動力伝達機構から構成され る。

docs.title: シート供給装置及びこれを用いる画像処理装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】揺動する積載台を持つシート供給装置におい て、送り手段へのシート突入位置の変動を少なくする。
【解決手段】シート供給トレイ１８にはシートを多数積 載する積載台５６が揺動自在に設けられている。この積 載台５６の上部に供給ヘッド２０が設けられ、この供給 ヘッド２０は、ナジャーロール６４、フィードロール６ ６及びリタードロール６８とから構成され、ナジャーロ ール６４の回転により積載台５６のシートがフィードロ ール６６とリタードロール６８とのニップ部８０へ押出 される。ナジャーロール６４のシート押出し位置は位置 検出手段８６により検出される。積載台５６のシート残 量が少なくなると、ナジャーロール６４から押出される シートの角度が上昇するが、ナジャーロール６４のシー ト押出し位置が積載台５６のシート残量に応じて制御さ れ、ナジャーロール６４から押出されたシートは適正範 囲内でリタードロール６８に突き当てることができる。

docs.title: シート材給送装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  シート材に走行負荷を与えずにシートガイド 部材を適切に位置決めできる安価なシート材給送装置を 提供する。
【解決手段】  シート材収容部でのシート材の収容位置 を規制するガイド機構の構成として、ガイドシャフト４ にサイドガイド５を摺動可能に係止するとともに、ガイ ドシャフト４の一端４ａを押し戻し用の圧縮コイルバネ １２を介してスラスト軸受部材９に嵌合した。そして、 シート材１３の端部に向けてサイドガイド５を摺動させ た際に、その摺動抵抗によって圧縮コイルバネ１２を圧 縮変形させ、シート材１３の端部にサイドガイド５を押 し付けて係止した際には、圧縮コイルバネ１２の反力で スライドシャフト４と一緒にサイドガイド５を押し戻 し、これによってシート材１３の端部とサイドガイド５ との間に微小ギャップｇを確保するようにした。

docs.title: シート部材供給装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  受像材料等のシート部材を正確な姿勢で供給 できるシート部材供給装置を得る。
【解決手段】  受像材料４２を吸着して搬送する吸盤１ ７２の前方には、受像材料４２を挟持した状態で回転し て送り出す搬送ローラ２５６、２５８が配置されてお り、吸盤１７２によって搬送された受像材料４２の先端 部が搬送ローラ２５６、２５８へ突き当てられる。ここ で、吸盤１７２は弾性変形可能であり、また、吸盤１７ ２による受像材料４２の搬送速度は搬送ローラ２５６の 回転周速度よりも速い。このため受像材料４２の姿勢が ずれて、先端部の幅方向一端が幅方向他端よりも先に搬 送ローラ２５６、２５８へ突き当たった場合には、幅方 向一端が搬送ローラ２５６、２５８の間へ挟み込まれる 前に、搬送ローラ２５６からの反力によって吸盤１７２ が弾性変形して、受像材料４２の姿勢を修正する。

docs.title: シート搬送装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  シートのジャム処理時における弾性ゲート部 材の変形を防止し得るシート搬送装置を提供する。
【解決手段】  弾性ゲート部材５を有する搬送路切り替 え部６を備え、この搬送路切り替え部６を露出させるべ く、シートガイド７の少なくとも一部が通路内部に滞留 したシート１０を除去処理可能な方向に移動する可動シ ートガイド７ａとなっているシート搬送装置であって、 可動シートガイド７ａの少なくとも弾性ゲート部材５と 対向する部分を固定ガイド部８とする。また、弾性ゲー ト部材５を回転支持部材５ａにて回転可能に支持した。 さらに、可動シートガイド７ａの開放時に、可動シート ガイド７ａに連動して弾性ゲート部材５をジャム処理時 のシート１０と接触しない位置まで待避させる。

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】  現像剤中の劣化したトナーを減らすことができる画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】  像保持体と、像保持体の表面を帯電させる帯電器と、露光器と、現像器とを備え、帯電器が、像保持体の表面のうち、予め決められた端部を除いた本体部を帯電させる主帯電部と、端部を、主帯電部とは異なる帯電電位に帯電させる副帯電部とを備えたものであり、現像器が、像保持体に面した現像領域へと搬送する現像ロールと、トナー供給口よりも下流側で現像剤を表面に保持する搬送体と、搬送体とは電位差を有する、この電位差で、搬送体によって搬送中の現像剤から上記トナーを吸着する吸着体とを備えた。 【選択図】        図２

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】  現像剤中の劣化したトナーを減らすことができる画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】  潜像形成部によって潜像が形成される面の広がる方向に像保持体と並んだ、表面の電位が像保持体の表面電位とは独立な独立部材と、独立部材の表面を帯電させる帯電器とを備え、現像器が、像保持体および独立部材の双方に隣り合った、現像剤を像保持体に面した現像領域および独立部材に面した対向領域へと搬送する現像ロールと、現像ロールに隣り合い現像ロールの回転軸に沿って延びた、独立部材から遠い方から独立部材に近づく方へと向かう第１方向に、収容した現像剤を搬送する第１収容部と、第１収容部に隣接し第１収容部に並んで延びた、両端に、第１収容部との間で現像剤が移動する移動口が設けられた、第１方向とは逆の第２方向に、収容した現像剤を搬送する第２収容部と、トナー供給口を通じて第２収容部へトナーを供給するトナー供給部とを備えた。 【選択図】        図２

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】  接触帯電装置を備える現像同時クリーニング方式の画像形成装置において、接触帯電装置への残留トナーの付着を低減し、カブリやスジ等の画質欠陥の発生を抑制する。 【解決手段】  導電性支持体及び感光層を有する電子写真感光体７と、感光体７を所定の極性に帯電させる接触帯電装置８と、感光体７表面に静電潜像を形成する露光装置１０と、静電潜像を、感光体７と逆極性に帯電したトナーにより現像してトナー像を形成する現像装置１１と、転写装置１２と、転写後の残留トナーを接触帯電装置８の極性と同極性に帯電させるトナー帯電装置１７と、を備え、現像装置１１は、残留トナーを回収することが可能であり、感光層は、６００〜９００ｎｍの波長域での分光吸収スペクトルにおいて、８１０〜８３９ｎｍの範囲に最大ピーク波長を有するヒドロキシガリウムフタロシアニンを含有している画像形成装置。 【選択図】  図３

docs.title: 現像装置及びこれを用いた画像形成装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】一成分現像剤のトナーを担持搬送する現像剤担持体の表面に着目し、現像剤担持体での現像履歴によるゴーストの発生を抑制した現像装置及びこれを用いた画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】静電潜像が担持される像担持体１に対向して開口し且つトナーが収容可能な現像ハウジング２と、現像ハウジング２の開口に面して配設され且つ外周面にてトナーが担持搬送可能な現像剤担持体３とを備え、現像剤担持体３は、算術平均粗さ（Ｒａ）が１．５μｍ以上であり、かつ、算術平均傾斜（Δａ）が０．１以上０．４以下の表面粗さを具備する。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】最小限の調整時間で所定の画像濃度が得られる 制御手段を備えた画像形成装置を提供することを目的と する。
【解決手段】二成分現像剤を保持した現像装置３を用い て記録媒体上に定着トナー像からなる画像を形成する画 像形成装置において、現像剤のトナー濃度を測定するト ナー濃度測定手段と、基準電位の基準トナー像の濃度を 測定するトナー像濃度測定手段と、基準トナー像の濃度 の、所定の目標濃度からの偏差に応じて現像剤中のトナ ー濃度を増減させるトナー濃度調整手段とを備え、偏差 と、現像剤中のトナー濃度の濃度領域内に応じて選択さ れた変換係数との双方に基づいて、現像装置内のトナー を増減させる。

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  像担持体上の潜像にトナーを選択的に付着し て可視像とした後、記録材に転写する画像形成装置にお いて、転写効率を向上して廃棄トナーの発生量を少なく するとともに、長期にわたり安定した画質を得る。
【解決手段】  像担持体１と対向して現像装置４を配設 し、該現像装置内に収容されるトナーに、これより小粒 径の微粒子を外添する。このとき、微粒子の外添被覆率 が１００％以上のトナー粒子を、現像装置内のトナー中 に３wt% 以上、３０wt% 以下含ませるように調整する。 また、像担持体１と現像装置４との間にはＡＣ電界を作 用させる。これにより、トナーが像担持体１と現像装置 ４との間で往復運動し、像担持体１と繰り返し接触する ため、像担持体上で微粒子がならされほぼ均一に分散付 着する。

docs.title: 画像形成装置、画像形成カートリッジ、および現像カートリッジ
docs.abstract: 【課題】本発明は、トナーの無駄や生産性の低下の無い画像形成装置、および前記画像形成装置に装着される画像形成カートリッジおよび現像カートリッジの提供。 【解決手段】転写画像形成領域１６Ａの外側にトナー消費画像が形成される感光体ドラム１６と、感光体ドラム１６の表面に形成された潜像をトナーで現像して前記転写トナー画像および前記トナー消費画像とする現像ユニット７４と、感光体ドラム１６の表面に形成されたトナー消費画像を除去してトナーを回収するトナー回収ブレード２０Ｂとを備え、前記現像ユニット７４は、現像ローラ１２６とトナーを含有する現像剤を現像ローラ１２６に沿って搬送して現像ローラ１２６にトナーを付着させる攪拌搬送オーガ１１６、１２０を有し、トナー消費画像は、感光体ドラム１６におけるトナーまたは現像剤の搬送方向の下流側の領域に形成される画像形成装置。 【選択図】図５

docs.title: 画像形成装置および画像形成装置のクリーニング方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】感光体表面を磨耗することなく放電生成物を長期わたって継続的に除去することが可能であり、これによって感光体のロングライフ化と放電生成物除去による画像白抜け防止を両立できる画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】感光体ドラムの側周に、感光体ドラムの回転方向Ａに沿って、像担持面に静電潜像を形成する帯電装置および露光装置、この静電潜像をトナーで現像して像担持面にトナー像を形成する現像装置、およびトナー像を転写媒体に転写する転写ロールがこの順に配置された画像形成装置において、転写ロールと帯電手段との間には、像担持面に当接されると共に感光体ドラムの回転方向Ａを横切る方向に延設された複数の溝ｄを備えたトナー保持面１６ａを有する放電生成物除去手段が配置されていることを特徴としている。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 放射線画像検出器及びその製造方法、並びに放射線画像検出器を用いた放射線撮影システム
docs.abstract: 【課題】被写体の放射線位相イメージングにおける位相情報の精度を高める放射線画像検出器を提供する。 【解決手段】通過する放射線によって周期的強度分布を含む放射線像を形成する放射線遮蔽部３１ｂと、放射線を検出して電荷を蓄積する複数の画素４０が行列状に配列されてなる受像部４１と、受像部４１を支持する支持体３１ａとを、備え、受像部４１によって放射線像を検出し、該放射線像に含まれる周期的強度分布に基づく周期パターンを含む画像データを生成する放射線画像検出器３０であって、放射線遮蔽部３１ｂは、支持体３１ａに形成されている放射線画像検出器３０。 【選択図】図５

docs.title: 放射線画像撮影装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】撮影対象者による不快感を低減することができると共に、撮影時における使い勝手を向上させることのできる放射線画像撮影装置を得る。 【解決手段】放射線が照射されることにより光を発生するシンチレータ８、当該シンチレータ８で発生した光を受光することにより電荷が発生する有機光電変換材料を含んで構成されたセンサ部、および当該センサ部で発生された電荷を読み出すための薄膜トランジスタが形成されたＴＦＴ基板３０を有する放射線検出器２０が収容された放射線検出ユニット４２を、少なくとも放射線検出器２０により放射線画像の撮影を行う際に放射線Ｘの照射方向に対して、放射線検出器２０の動作を制御する制御部５０が収容された制御ユニット４３に重ならないように当該制御ユニット４３の側方に位置され、かつ厚さを制御ユニット４３に比較して薄くする。 【選択図】図１３

docs.title: 放射線画像検出器、放射線画像撮像装置、及び放射線画像撮像システム
docs.abstract: 【課題】３画素のビニング処理の前後で６方向の解像度を維持した放射線画像検出器を提供する。 【解決手段】放射線検出器４２の画素領域が六角形状の複数の画素２０のうち、各々が３画素からなる複数の画素群について、放射線検出器４２内で３画素分の電荷をまとめて読み取り、これら３画素の電荷信号を合成して、チャージアンプで順次、積分する。さらに、特定の画素群に対しては、その画素群を構成する３画素のうち、２画素分の電荷信号と、残りの１画素分の電荷信号とを、同一のチャージアンプの積分タイミングをずらして加算する。これにより、３画素のビニング処理を行う。 【選択図】図２

docs.title: 放射線撮影装置、及び、そのプログラム
docs.abstract: 【課題】  胸部に現れる異常陰影などの検出を高性能に行う。 【解決手段】  複数の線源位置から被写体５をＸ線撮影するトモシンセシス撮影を行う際に、被写体５の心拍位相を検出し、複数の各線源位置において、検出された心拍位相が同一位相のときに、被写体５をＸ線撮影する。 【選択図】          図２

docs.title: 放射線撮影システム及び放射線撮影方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】被写体の位相イメージングを行う放射線撮影システム及び放射線撮影方法において、イメージングの精度向上を図る。 【解決手段】放射線撮影システム１０は、Ｘ線源１１と、第１の透過型格子３１と、第２の透過型格子３２と、第２の透過型格子３２を移動させる走査機構３３と、第１及び第２の透過型格子３１，３２を透過したＸ線を検出するフラットパネル検出器３０と、フラットパネル検出器３０で取得される複数の画像に基づき、被写体の位相コントラスト画像を生成する演算処理部２２と、を備え、演算処理部２２は、屈折角の分布像を構成する各画素の画素値に対して、その画素に対応したフラットパネル検出器３０の画素４０の、第２の透過型格子３２の走査方向に関する、入射放射線に対しての実効幅Ｄ´に応じた感度補正を行い、補正された屈折角の分布像に基づいて位相コントラスト画像を生成する。 【選択図】図１０

docs.title: 放射線撮影装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】撮影後に最適な照射線量を簡単かつ迅速に確認することを可能とする。 【解決手段】Ｘ線画像検出装置は、撮像部、線量検出部、照射判定部、累積線量判定部、照射時間算出部を有する。線量検出部は、撮像部に入射するＸ線の線量を検出する。照射判定部は、線量検出部により検出される線量に基づいて、回診車からのＸ線の照射開始を判定する。累積線量判定部は、線量検出部により検出される線量を積算して累積線量を周期的に算出し、この累積線量が適正値に達する時刻ｔ１を判定する。照射時間算出部は、照射判定部によりＸ線照射が開始されたと判定された時刻ｔ０から、累積線量判定部により判定された時刻ｔ１までの適正照射時間Ｔ１を算出する。適正照射時間Ｔ１は、コンソールに送信され、コンソールの表示部に表示される。 【選択図】図８

docs.title: 放射線画像撮影装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】リセット動作に起因して発生する放射線画像の段差を補正することができる放射線画像撮影装置を提供する。 【解決手段】マトリクス状に設けられた複数の画素２０に蓄積された電荷を取り出して除去するリセット動作を、列方向とは交差する行方向に配列された画素２０のライン毎に繰り返し行い、放射線の照射開始が検出された際にリセット動作を停止し、放射線の照射終了後に、生成された画像情報における、リセット動作を停止した際にリセット動作が行われていた画素２０のラインの画像情報を、列方向に隣接する画素２０のラインの画像情報から補間する。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 放射線画像検出装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】  漏れ電荷による残像の発生を低減する。 【解決手段】  放射線検出装置１は、放射線画像情報を担持した電磁波を透過する上部平面電極２１と、電磁波の照射により電荷を発生する電荷発生層２２と、電荷発生層２２において発生した電荷を収集する複数の分割電極２３とを有している。この分割電極２３は、上部平面電極２１に対して傾いている傾斜電極面２３ｂを備えている。 【選択図】  図１

docs.title: Printing system, printing control device, and printing control program
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a printing system, a printing control device, and a printing control program for easily printing print data with an arbitrary printout destination set thereto by mutual cooperation between printing control devices, from a desired printer on a communication network.  <P>SOLUTION: A printer B receiving instructions to print the print data related to a print request makes a request to transfer the print data requested by a print request terminal, to a print server B. The print server B acquires the print data from a print server A and transfers the image data to the printer B for list display.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Print control device and print control system
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a print control device and a print control system capable of shortening a processing time required by a print device from the start of receiving data required for printout to the completion of printing based on the data as compared to the case that the print device performs print processing after receiving the data required for the printout which is generated by a device at a requesting side based on the data received from a database.  <P>SOLUTION: A print server 1 includes: a job acceptance means 10A for accepting a variable job file from a terminal device 4; a database query cursor management means 10D for specifying a record to obtain data from the database 2 based on the variable job file; a variable data generation means 10C for successively generating variable data by using the obtained data; and a variable data transmission means 10F for successively transmitting the variable data to a printer 3.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Photofinishing system
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a customer to easily and surely obtain convenience being equal to network photo service by printing the retrieval ID information of a prescribed recording medium for image data on the prescribed recording medium according to a prescribed forth and outputting it. SOLUTION: A print 6 is produced at a simultaneous printing time and an order print 9 is produced by printing the retrieval ID information used when the print is ordered on a prescribed paper and outputting it. The customer orders the print by writing necessary matters such as the number of printing sheets on the sheet 9 and giving it to an operator or sending it to a photo studio from his/her home by a facsimile equipment. By the photo studio receiving the order, the information of the order is inputted to an image server 3 by using an order information input means 5. By the server 3, photographic image data specified based on the retrieval ID information inputted from the input means 5 is retrieved from the stored photographic image data and outputted as the print by a printer 4.

docs.title: Image processor
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image processor with which the kind of printing or the position of printing is not limited in the case of printing the completion of processing or serial numbers onto originals. SOLUTION: Original information read by an original input part 1 is temporarily stored in an image; memory part 20. A processor part 22 sends one part of data stored in the image memory part 20 to an image output part 2, prints them on this original information and executes instructed processing. Since this printing is performed by processing at the processor part 22, the kind or position of printing is not limited. Besides, it can be discriminated from the result of printing onto the original information whether the original information is properly read and recognized or not. In this vase, a predetermined image is printed on this original so as to easily recognize the correspondence between the original information and the output of the processing result or the result calculated based on the recognized result of original information is printed on this original.

docs.title: Device, system and program for document management
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a document management device, a document management system and a document management program for which printing is performed with the same print parameter as that applied when a form is printed, even when a print source document is acquired from the page ID of a scanned form and printed.  <P>SOLUTION: An electronic document to be printed is stored in an electronic document storage section 22, and metadata such as a paper document or the like output from an image processor 10 is stored in a metadata storage section 21. When a reproduction instruction of the paper document is carried out by the image processor 10, a print parameter used for printing the paper document is acquired from the metadata storage section 21, and printing is carried out on the basis of the print parameter.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Printing system, printer, print data generating device and program for generating print data
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make the degree of security high in a printing system in which a print data generating device and a printer are connected through a network. SOLUTION: A client PC 10 for generating print data generates a control program for controlling a printing operation in the printer 40, associates the generated control program with pregenerated print contents and outputs the control program associated with the pregenerated print contents as print data. The printer 40 separates the print data acquired from a print data generating device between the control program and the print contents and prints the separated print contents while controlling a printing operation according to the separated and extracted control program. Since the client PC 10 side can freely set a security mechanism by thinking out a control program, the degree of security can be made higher than that of a simple authentication number.

docs.title: Printing system, print control unit, and print control program
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To select a printer intended by a user.  <P>SOLUTION: When receiving a print job from a client terminal 30, a printer decision part 253 in a print server 20 selects a printer 30 based on the print job and print refusal information stored in a print refusal information management table 232. A printer confirmation control part 254 performs processing to make the user of the client terminal 10 of the transmission source of the print job confirm whether to permit printing by the selected printer 30, and when it is decided that it is confirmed that printing is refused based on the confirmation result to be responded and transmitted from the client terminal 10, a print refusal information management part 256 updates the print refusal information of the pertinent printer 30 in a print denial information management table 232.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Photographic print assortment apparatus, method and system, and digital still camera
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a photographic print to be simply send to a designated destination.  <P>SOLUTION: The delivery address data of the photographic print 13 is registered together with image data as ancillary information on a memory card 23. A photographic printer 16 reads the delivery destination data from the memory card 23 and writes the data to a radio tag 46 embedded into the photographic print 13 printed with the image. A sorter 17 reads the delivery address data from the radio tag 46 and assorts the photographic prints 13 by each of the delivery destinations. The photographic prints 13 rearranged by each delivery destination are packed and delivered. Therefore a user placing an order on the print is able to send the photographic print 13 without carrying out delivery work by himself or herself.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a photosensitive material used for infrared exposure, small in change of sensitivity and fog due to storage and enhanceable in processing speed by incorporating a specified compound having a >=95mol% silver chloride content in a silver halide emulsion and regulating the water content of the photosensitive material in the range of 3 - 10wt.%. CONSTITUTION:The silver halide color photographic sensitive material has 3 kinds of silver halide photosensitive layers different from each other in spectrally sensitizing wavelength region on a support, and at least one of the photosensitive layers contains in the silver halide emulsion the >=95mol% silver chloride and one of the compounds represented by formula I in which Z<11> is a nonmetallic atomic group necessary to form a 5- or 6-membered N-containing hetero ring; R<11> is H, alkyl, or alkenyl; R<12> is H or lower alkyl; and X<11> is an acid anion. The photosensitive material is regulated to the water content range of 3 - 10wt.%, thus permitting the obtained photosensitive material to be sensitized in the infrared region and superior in storage stability and easily and rapidly processable.

docs.title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the silver halide color photographic sensitive material superior in color developing performance and fastness of a color image and improved in color reproduction performance by making it contain a specified compound, CONSTITUTION:The silver halide color photographic sensitive material has on a support at least one silver halide emulsion layer and it is characterized by containing at least one kind f cyan coupler represented by the formula and in at least one of the silver halide emulsion layers, negative latent image type silver halide grains chemically sensitized from the surface of each grain to the depth of <=0.02mmu. In formula, R<1> is H or a substituent: R<2> is a substituent: X is H or a group to be released by coupling with the oxidation product of a color developing agent; and Z<1> is a nonmetallic atomic group necessary to form an N-containing 6-membered hetero ring.

docs.abstract: A yellow color forming photographic coupler represented by the following general formula (I)    <IMAGE>  (I)  in which X represents an aliphatic group, an aromatic group or a heterocyclic group; Y represents a hydrogen atom or a coupling off group; R1 and R2 each represents an aliphatic group, or R1 and R2 can combine to form a ring; and R3 and R4 each represents a hydrogen atom, an aliphatic group, an aromatic group or a heterocyclic group.

docs.title: Color-forming aminopyrimidine couplers and silver halide color photographic light-sensitive materials containing the coupler
docs.abstract:
A color-forming aminopyrimidine coupler represented by formula (I): ##STR1## where R 1 , R 2 , and R 3  independently represent a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, an alkoxy group, an aryloxy group, a heterocyclic-oxy group, an alkylthio group, an arylthio group, a heterocyclic-thio group, a substituted or unsubstitued amino group, a heterocyclic group bonding to the pyrimidine ring via a nitrogen atom thereof, an alkyl group or an aryl group; provided that at least one of R 1 , R 2  and R 3  is an unsubstituted or substituted amino group, and that when any one of R 1 , R 2  or R 3  contains a sulfonic acid group or a salt thereof, R 1  , R 2  or R 3  contains at least one linear or branched alkyl group and that the total carbon atoms in the alkyl group(s) are to be more than 8; and R 4  represents a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, an alkoxy group, an aryloxy group, a heterocyclic-oxy group, an alkylthio group, an arylthio group, a heterocyclic-thio group, a substituted or unsubstituted amino group, or a heterocyclic group bonding to the pyrimidine ring via a nitrogen atom thereof. 
     At least one coupler of formula (I) is incorporated into the photographic constitutive layer of a color silver halide photographic material, which gives a color image with high heat-fastness.

docs.title: Silver halide color reversal photographic sensitive material for photographing
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the silver halide color reversal photographic sensitive material for photographing superior in color reproduction performance, especially, reproduction of colors reflecting light longer in wavelength than 650nm like purple, red, bluish purple, and deep green, and superior in the color saturation of red reproduction. CONSTITUTION:This photosensitive material has a blue-sensitive silver halide emulsion layer containing an yellow coupler, a green-sensitive silver halide emulsion layer containing a magenta coupler, and a red-sensitive silver halide emulsion layer containing a cyan coupler. The maximum sensitivity wavelength lambdaRmax of the red-sensitive emulsion layer, its sensitivity SRmax, and its sensitivity of SR660 at 660nm is characterized by satisfying the following conditions: 630 nm<=lambdaRmax<=650nm, and 0.005SRmax<=SR660<=0.2SRmax.

docs.title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the photosensitive material which is high in desilvering rate and has the adaptability to rapid processing by incorporating fine silver halide particles which have <0.15mum average size and contain the silver chloride adsorbed with a compd. forming the silver salt having the harder solubility than silver bromide at >=50mol% and incorporating at least one kind of compds. which release a bleach accelerating compd. CONSTITUTION:The silver halide color photographic sensitive material having <0.15mum average size and at least >=1 layers of silver halide emulsion layers on a base contains the silver chloride adsorbed with the compd. forming the silver salt having the harder solubility than silver bromide at >=50mol% and contains at least one kind of the compds. which release the bleach accelerating compd. Further the superfine particles have preferably <0.13mum average size, more particularly preferably <0.1mum. The high desilvering rate and the adaptability to the rapid processing is obtd. in this way.

docs.title: Silver halide photographic sensitive material
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To change the color tone of a silver image to a warm tone, without deteriorating the sensitivity of the titled material by incorporating at least one of specified compds. in an emulsion layer or its adjacent layer. CONSTITUTION:At least one of the compds. shown by the formula is incorporated in the emulsion layer or its adjacent layer, PWR may be a group which contains an electron receiving center and an intramolecular nucleophilic substituting reaction center in the compd. capable of releasing a photographic reagent by the intramolecular nucleophilic substituting reaction after reducing said compd. And, PWR may be a group which contains an electron receiving quinonoid center and a carbon atom bonding said center and the photographic reagent in the compd. capable of releasing the photographic reagent by the intramolecular electron transfer reaction after reducing said compd. Thus, the color tone can be changed to the warm tone, without deteriorating the sensitivity of the titled material.

docs.title: 黒白熱現像感光材料
docs.abstract: 【課題】  本発明の課題は、高感度で高い画像濃度を与える黒白熱現像感光材料を提供することである。 【解決手段】  支持体の少なくとも一方の面上に、少なくとも感光性ハロゲン化銀、非感光性有機銀塩、還元剤、およびバインダーを含む画像形成層を有する黒白熱現像感光材料であって、該感光性ハロゲン化銀粒子の全投影面積の５０％以上が、下記（１）、（２）および（３）の要件を満たす感光性ハロゲン化銀粒子で占められていることを特徴とする黒白熱現像感光材料：       （１）アスペクト比が２以上の平板状粒子であり、       （２）少なくとも一つのエピタキシャル接合を有し、       （３）該エピタキシャル部に少なくとも１本の転位線を有する。 【選択図】    なし

docs.title: 黒白熱現像感光材料
docs.abstract: 【課題】本発明の課題は、高感度で画像色調に優れ、さらに保存安定性に優れた黒白熱現像感光材料を提供することである。 【解決手段】支持体上の少なくとも一方の面上に、少なくとも感光性ハロゲン化銀、非感光性有機銀塩、および発色現像薬を含有する感光性層、および該発色現像薬の酸化生成物と反応して色素を形成し得るカプラーを含有する非感光性層を有する黒白熱現像感光材料であって、前記非感光性層のバインダーの少なくとも３０質量％がポリマーラテックスであり、かつ該黒白熱現像感光材料を画像露光して熱現像して形成される画像の光学濃度が下記式（Ａ）を満足することを特徴とする黒白熱現像感光材料：     式（Ａ）      ０．０２  ＜  Ｄｃ  ＜  Ｄ／４ （式中、Ｄは光学濃度が１．０以上２．０以下の範囲の値を表す。Ｄｃは該光学濃度における発色色素による光学濃度を表す。）。 【選択図】なし

docs.title: 黒白熱現像感光材料
docs.abstract: 【課題】現像活性が高く現像における遅れが解消され、高感度でＤｍｉｎが低く、且つ画像保存性に優れており、連続出力時の画像安定性にも優れた熱現像感光材料を提供する。 【解決手段】少なくとも１種類の感光性ハロゲン化銀、銀イオンのための還元剤、バインダーおよび非感光性有機銀塩を有する熱現像感光材料であって、該非感光性有機銀塩粒子のベヘン酸銀含有率が４５モル％以上９２モル％未満であり、融点が５０℃以上２００℃以下である熱溶剤および下記一般式（Ｂ）で表される化合物を含有することを特徴とする黒白熱現像感光材料。 一般式（Ｂ）　　　Ｑ−（Ｙ）ｎ−Ｃ（Ｚ １ ）（Ｚ ２ ）Ｘ （一般式（Ｂ）において、Ｑはアルキル基、アリール基またはヘテロ環基を表し、Ｙは２価の連結基を表し、ｎは０または１を表し、Ｚ １ およびＺ ２ はハロゲン原子を表し、Ｘは水素原子または電子求引性基を表す。） 【選択図】　　　なし

docs.title: 白黒熱現像感光材料および画像形成方法
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】高濃度の銀画像を得ることができる熱現像感光 材料及びそれを用いた画像形成方法を提供すること。
【解決手段】支持体上に、感光性ハロゲン化銀、バイン ダー、および還元剤として、１−フェニル−３−ピラゾ リドン誘導体と特定構造のスルホンアミド化合物を含有 する白黒熱現像感光材料、ならびにそれを用いた画像形 成方法が提供される。

docs.title: 黒白熱現像感光材料
docs.abstract: 【課題】本発明の課題は、高画質で生保存安定性および画像保存安定性に優れた黒白熱現像感光材料を提供することにある。 【解決手段】支持体の一方の面上に、少なくとも感光性ハロゲン化銀、非感光性有機銀塩、および有機銀塩のための還元剤、およびバインダーを有する画像形成層を有する黒白熱現像感光材料であって、水不溶性かつ有機溶剤可溶性の写真有用素材および水不溶性かつ有機溶剤可溶性のポリマーを含む乳化分散粒子を含有することを特徴とする。 【選択図】なし

docs.title: 黒白熱現像感光材料
docs.abstract: 【課題】  本発明の課題は、現像活性が高く、指跡による変色が少ない黒白熱現像感光材料を提供することである。 【解決手段】  支持体の一方面上に、少なくとも、感光性ハロゲン化銀、非感光性有機銀塩、銀イオンのための還元剤、及びバインダーを含有する画像形成層を有する黒白熱現像感光材料であって、前記非感光性有機銀塩が、含窒素ヘテロ環化合物の銀塩を含み、前記バインダーが、疎水性ポリマーの水分散物を含有することを特徴とする黒白熱現像感光材料。 【選択図】    なし

docs.title: 黒白熱現像感光材料
docs.abstract: 【課題】画像色調に優れ、さらに保存安定性に優れた黒白熱現像感光材料の提供。 【解決手段】支持体の面上に、感光性ハロゲン化銀、非感光性有機銀塩、下記一般式（Ｉ）で表される還元剤、および該化合物の酸化生成物と反応して色素を形成し得るカプラー、及びバインダーを含有し、実質的に感光波長域が同一である２層の異なる画像形成層を有する黒白熱現像感光材料：     式中、Ｒ １ 、Ｒ ２ 、Ｒ ３ 及びＲ ４ はそれぞれ独立に水素原子又は置換基を表し、Ｒ ５ 及びＲ ６ はそれぞれ独立にアルキル基、アリール基、ヘテロ環基、アシル基又はスルホニル基を表し、Ｒ １ とＲ ２ 、Ｒ ３ とＲ ４ 、Ｒ ５ とＲ ６ 、Ｒ ２ とＲ ５ 又は／及びＲ ４ とＲ ６ とが互いに結合して５員、６員又は７員の環を形成してもよい。 【選択図】なし

docs.title: 黒白熱現像感光材料および画像形成方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】改良された黒白熱現像感光材料および画像形成方法に関し、特に高感度、低かぶりであり、かつ、好ましい階調を有し銀色調に優れた高画質の黒白熱現像感光材料および画像形成方法を提供する。 【解決手段】支持体の少なくとも一方面上に、少なくとも、感光性ハロゲン化銀、非感光性有機銀塩、銀イオンのための還元剤、およびバインダーを含有する画像形成層を有する黒白熱現像感光材料および画像形成方法であって、１）前記バインダーが親水性バインダーを含有し、２）前記感光性ハロゲン化銀がアニオン性カルコゲニドと金（I）カチオンとの結合を有し、金−カルコゲンアニオン種を放出し得る金増感剤、および一般式（II）で表される金増感剤より選ばれる少なくとも１つで金増感されていることを特徴とする黒白熱現像感光材料および画像形成方法；    一般式（II）     【選択図】なし

docs.title: Positioning device for original in copying machine
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To adopt a simple mechanism of a center resist system for feeding copying paper and to make the setting of an original easy, by providing a means for detecting original sizes and a means for moving the original up to the center of platen glass in accordance with the information on the original size. CONSTITUTION:A means 26 for detecting original sizes is constituted of light sources 27, 28 and photosensors 29, 30 which correspond respectively to the positions for the B4 and A3 sizes of originals. When the original of the B4 size is placed on the corner of platen glass 3 while a platen cover 1 is held open, the light of the light source 27 is interrupted by the original and the light of the light source 28 is detected with the sensor 30. A solenoid stopper 24 is then held in the projected state. When the cover 1 is closed, a disc 12 turned by the movement thereof collides against the stopper 24 and is prevented from movement. Therefore, a belt 7 turned with a pulley 5 moves leftward by the distance corresponding to the turning range of the disc 12, thereby moving the original up to the center of the glass 3. The similar operations are accomplished in the case of the original of the A4 size.

docs.title: Original size detecting device of copying machine
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To detect exactly an existence of an original by setting a photodetecting signal which has received directly light of a face-shaped light emitting body provided on a platen cover, as a reference value, and comparing this value with a photodetecting signal received through the original on a platen. CONSTITUTION:An original 2 is run against a registration guide 5 and positioned in advance on a platen, and held by a platen cover 4. Light of a face-shaped light emitting body 6 providing on the platen cover 4 is detected by a photodetector 9 in a carriage 10. The carriage 10 scans the lower face of the original 2, basing on as a reference a signal value of the photodetector 9 when light coming through the transparent registration guide 5 has been detected, and the photodetector 9 compares a signal value when light coming by transmitting through the original 2 is received, with the previous value, by which a range in which the original exists is known.

docs.title: Overhead projector
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To move the picture of optional part of a transparent original placed on a stage, to the center of the stage by forming a roughly U-shaped bent part projecting to the outside from a machine body, on the lower part of a support, and forming the upper face of the lower wall of this bent part to the almost same plane as the upper face of the machine body. CONSTITUTION:A roughly U-shaped bent part 8 projecting to the outside from a machine body 6 is formed on the lower part of a support 7, the upper face of the lower wall of this bent part 8 is formed to the almost same plane as the upper face of said machine body 6, and on the other hand, a projection lens 9 and a reflecting mirror 10 are attached to the tip part of said support 7. Even if a transparent original 14 placed on a stage 13 is moved horizontally in the forward and backward, and left and right directions on the surface of its stage 13, the end part of the original 13 does not hit the support 7, and accordingly, a picture of an optical part of the original 14 can be moved freely to the center of the stage 13. Especially, this projector has a remarkable effect in case of executing a partially magnifying projection of the original 14.

docs.title: Overhead projector
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To form a secondary original while keystone correction is executed by processing a reading signal from a reading head,newly incorporating a keystone correction means and recording on a recording medium with a recording head based on the process signal. CONSTITUTION:When a screen is set, the position and the height of an overhead projector are estimated by considering the size of an image on the screen surface 35 and the convenience for the user of the projector. If the user wants to adjust the height of the projected image, the angle of mirror is adjusted. When the angle of mirror is out of 45 deg., the process for the keystone correction is added to a copying mechanism. When the angle of mirror is not altered and it is 45 deg., a keystone effect is not given to the projected image. Then, the secondary original is formed in the ratio 1:1 in a copying device. Thus, the secondary original whose magnification on the screen is kept constant without depending on a spot can be formed.

docs.title: Original size detecting device of copying machine
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To detect exactly an original size by connecting optically a sensor head and a detecting means by an optical fiber so as to detect whether an original exists or not, and the original size. CONSTITUTION:The end face is placed in a sensor head 19 by using a single optical fiber cable 18. The sensor head 19 is provided so that it can move at a prescribed speed in the directions A, B shown in the figure along the surface of a phosphor 15. The other end of the optical fiber cable 18 is connected to a light emitting element 23 having a branch part and a photodetector 24. An original 17 is placed at the prescribed position on a platen glass 15. The sensor head 19 executes a scan at a prescribed speed, and starts original detecting operation. A light is reflected at a part where the original 17 exists, passes through the optical fiber cable 18, and reaches a filter 25. In a part where the original does not exist, an optical signal from the light emitting element 23 is irradiated to a phosphor 16. In such a way, an original size can be detected.

docs.title: Copying machine with synchronously cutting mechanism
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To read the length of an original accurately by disposing two pieces of photosensors in the feed direction of the original at the spacing slightly larger than the diameter of the punched hole of an original paper. CONSTITUTION:The preceding end of an original 3 fed in an arrow direction is detected through reflection by a photosensor 1. When a punched hole P passes under the sensors 1, 2, the presence of the paper 3 is detected by either of the sensors 1, 2 because the spacing (d) between the sensors 1, and 2 is slightly larger than the diameter phi of the hole P; therefore, the succeeding end of the original paper is detected with the sensor 2. The length of the paper 3 detected with the sensor is thus longer by (d) than the actual size and is longer by d/v (v is the traveling speed of the original 3) in time. To correct such errors, the pulses 6 of the frequency proportional with the (v) are generated by an encoder, and are consumed by as much as the count number equal to the time d/v by a counter 7, and the pulses 8 after such consumption are counted, whereby the length of the original is obtained accurately.

docs.title: Preventing device for copying of secret document
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To perform secure control operation and eliminate a waste of forms, etc., even when a previously magnetized pattern is disordered by disturbance, and to obtain display different from other failures by stopping copying operation or disabling the identification of copy contents on sending a magnetic material on an original. CONSTITUTION:The original 2 is detected by a sensor 13 and sent to a gate 6 by a feed mode 13 and a roll 5 and a read head 4 detects whether there is a magnetic pattern on the original surface or not simultaneously. When the magnetic pattern is found, a binary-coded output signal is latched and a control circuit 17 operates a display and alarm device 16 to indicate that the original can not be copied and also stop copying operation. A normal original is set on a platen 8 by a feed belt 7 through the operation of a gate releasing solenoid 14 and then copied. The display and warning of disabled copying are changed or eliminated according to the purpose.

docs.title: Original press-contacting device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To simplify a device, and also to improve its work efficiency by switching automatically an original press-contacting member to an automatic opening and closing mode when a prescribed time elapses after an image forming operation has been ended, when a manual opening and closing mode has been selected. CONSTITUTION:When a solenoid S is energized, an oscillating member 11 oscillates in the direction (c), a gear 123 is detached from a gear 10, and an original press-contact plate 1 becomes a manual opening and closing mode. In this state, when a prescribed time elepses after an image forming operation has been ended, the solenoid S is de-energized, an operating lever 6 moves up and down by being driven by a motor 14 through the driving motor 14, a gear train 12, a fixed gear 10 and a rack 9, and an opening and closing arm 2 is oscillated upward and downward through a pivot shaft 7. Accordingly, opening and closing of the original press-contact plate 1 become an automatic opening and closing mode by the motor 14.

docs.title: Thermal head
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a thermal head capable of aligning two kinds of recorded dots in a straight line even in the case of high-speed printing, by a method wherein two heating resistors are provided in parallel to each other, and recording of one half of a line in a stroke by each of the resistors is conducted for the same line. CONSTITUTION:Two heating resistors 11, 12 are provided in parallel to each other, and end parts of the first electrodes 2a on one side are connected to the resistor 11. End parts of the second electrodes 2b on one side are passed under insulating films 13 spacedly provided on the lower side of the resistor 11, and are connected to the other resistor 12. The electrodes 2b are insulated from the resistor 11. End parts of electrodes 3 on the other side are connected in common to both of the resistors 11, 12. When a common terminal 5 is connected to a power source and all of the electrodes 3 on the other side 3 are grounded, only heating elements at parts indicated by non- shaped ellipses are supplied with an electric current to generate heat. When a common terminal 7 on the other side is connected to the power source and all of the electrodes 3 on the other side are grounded, only heating elements at parts indicated by the shaded ellipses are supplied with an electric current to generate heat. Namely, each of the heating resistors 11, 12 records one half of a line.

docs.title: Thermal head
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce uneven density of printing image by providing individual electrodes with slits for adjusting their resistances, so that each of the heating resistances connected to each of the individual electtrodes will become equal in electric power consumption. CONSTITUTION:A printed board 7 is attached with an adhesive agent to the left side of the surface of a supporting body 1 and an external connection wiring 8 is made on the surface of the printed board 7. The external connection wiring 8 is connected at its input end to a socket 10 for functioning as a driving signal input terminal via a lead pin 9 passing through the printed board 7. A driving IC is provided at a part near the insulating base plate 2 of the printed board 7. A thermal head H is composed of components 1-14 and driving IC and a thermal recording (printing) is performed with each heating resistance 5 pressed against heat-sensitive recording paper P on a platen R through a wear resisting layer 6.

docs.title: Electric heating element
docs.abstract: 1,261,748. Infra-red heating element. FUJI SHASHIN FILM K.K. 6 May, 1969 [18 May 1968], No. 23119/69. Heading H5H. To prevent a substantial area of the electrical heating strip '22 engaging the inside of heat resistant glass tube 21 on thermal expansion the strip 22 has at least one bent portion 23 intermediate its ends engaging the glass tube 21. Thus the bent portion or portions 23 absorb the thermal expansion and only the bent portion or portions of the strip engage the tube. 'The'bent portions may extend-on both sides of the ship as shown 'or on only one side 'thereof. The heat resistant tubes are made of quartz glass or crystalline glass. A plate heater was made from a plurality of glass tube heating elements of the type described above laid side by side with all the heating strips lying in the same plane, the glass tubes being cemented to transverse glass reinforcing tubes. The glass of the heating tubes consists of LiO 2 -Al 2 O 3 -SiO 2  with ZrO 2  added as a nucleii forming agent. An aluminium reflector plate was arranged on one side of the heating plate. The plate heater may be used in a surface heater or foot-warmer.

docs.title: Heat resistant communication cable
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To use a communication cable even in higher temperature environment by interposing radiation fins between a communication cable main body and an outer shell tube. CONSTITUTION:An outer shell tube 5 composed of stainless steel e.g. SUS 304, etc., covers the circumference of a communication cable main body 1, and radiation fins 6 are interposed between the outer shell tube 5 and the communication cable main body 1. The outer shell tube 5 can be sticked fast to the radiation fins 6 by drawing through a die. The radiation fins 6 are composed of e.g. copper, etc., having good heat conductivity, formed by two in a radius direction with the communication cable main body 1 as the center, extended parallel to the center line direction of the communication cable main body 1, and retain the communication cable main body 1 in apart from the outer shell tube 5. Coolant can be flown in a space demarcated with the radiation fins 6, the communication cable main body 1, and the outer shell tube 5. This improves heat resistance.

docs.title: Thermal head control method
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable printing with uniform density through using a simple construction, by supplying a printing signal to a thermal head, reciprocally moving the head in a scanning manner on a thermal recording paper, thereby performing desired printing on the paper, and bringing the head and the paper out of contact with each other upon the completion of printing. CONSTITUTION:A guide member 13 is provided with four notched parts 14a-14d. When a base 10 is driven in an auxiliary scanning direction, two rollers come out off the notched parts 14b, 14d, and roll along a side face 13a of the member 13, whereby the base 10 and a thermal head 9 are turned, and printing can be performed. At the time when printing in one line is finished and the rollers 12 are fitted into the notched parts 14a, 14c, the base 10 and the head 9 are turned as above, whereby the head 9 and a thermal recording paper 6 are brought out of contact with each other. Therefore, the ununiformity in density at a printing finishing part can be reduced, and the head 9 can be returned to a home position while making contact with the paper 6 after heat is dissipated from the head 9.

docs.title: Membrane thermal head
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a sharp printing dot in a sub-scanning division type printing system short in sub-scanning width executing the halftone recording in a membrane thermal head. CONSTITUTION:In a membrane thermal head 50 wherein an individually formed heating resistor 522 is provided between the individual opposed electrodes 533, 534 formed on an insulating substrate 51, a second overglaze layer 55 of which the sub-scanning width is narrower than the width of the gap 70 between the individual opposed electrodes 533, 534 and the height h1 is less than the height h2 of the first overglaze layer on the terminal parts of the electrodes is formed on the first overglaze layer (abrasion-resistant layer) 54. Since the part of the second overglaze layer 55 protruding from the surface of the thermal head 50 and heated on the heating resistor 522 certainly comes into close contact with a printing roller at a time of printing, a printing dot short in sub-scanning width can be sharply obtained when sub-scanning division type printing suitable for halftone recording is executed.

docs.title: Cleaning method for thermal head
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cleaning method for efficiently removing stains of a thermal head used in thermal recording in a short period of time.  <P>SOLUTION: An abrasive body 1 having an abrasive layer 3 including abrasives 4 and a binder 5 on a supporter 2 has a thickness of 100-1,000 μm and a surface roughness Ra of 0.1-0.7 μm. The abrasive layer 3 is brought in slide contact with a heating part 11a of the thermal head 11 to remove the stain. A contact pressure to the thermal head 11 is made appropriate by adjusting the thickness and the surface roughness, and the abrasive body 1 is sent similarly to a recording medium 7, so that cleaning is efficiently carried out without damaging the heating part 11a.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

docs.title: Temperature sensor for developing device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent energizing to processing liquid and a heater for dry wind heating unnecessarily in a wire disconnection state by measuring the temperature of the processing liquid and/or the temperature of dry wind by using a temperature sensing element having positive characteristics which increase in resistance value as measured temperature is raised. CONSTITUTION:The temperature sensor 34 has the positive characteristics which increase in resistance value as the temperature is raised. Therefore, when a wire disconnection accident occurs to intermediate parts or end parts of lead lines 42 and 44 or wires 46 and 48, a control means interrupts energizing to the heater by judging that the temperature of the liquid developer or dry wind exceeds a proper range according to the maximum resistance value as well as a case wherein the temperature sensor 34 detects the maximum temperature. Consequently, the temperature of the liquid developer or dry wind never exceeds the specific range. Consequently, the energizing to the heater is interrupted in case of the wire disconnection accident.

docs.title: 磁気記録媒体
docs.abstract: 【課題】高密度記録に適した磁性層の平滑性を達成でき、高い電磁変換特性を有する磁気記録媒体を提供する。 【解決手段】非磁性支持体の一方の面に、非磁性粉末および結合剤を含む非磁性層と、強磁性粉末および結合剤を含む磁性層とをこの順に有し、非磁性支持体の他方の面にバックコート層が設けられ、前記強磁性粉末が平均板径３０ｎｍ未満の強磁性六方晶フェライト粉末であり、前記磁性層の中心面表面粗さＲａが１．０〜２．５ｎｍであり、前記バックコート層のＲａが２．０〜４．０ｎｍであり、前記磁性層および非磁性層を含む塗布層のガラス転移点Ｔｇが７５〜１００℃であり、前記バックコート層のＴｇが７５〜１００℃であり、かつ前記磁性層のヤング率（Ｙｍ）とバックコート層のヤング率（Ｙｂ）の比（Ｒ＝Ｙｍ／Ｙｂ）が０．８〜１．２０である磁気記録媒体。 【選択図】なし

docs.title: 磁気記録媒体
docs.abstract: 【課題】高密度記録において安定したエラーレートと走行耐久性の両立化を低コストで実現できる磁気記録媒体を提供する。 【解決手段】非磁性支持体上に、放射線照射により重合可能な化合物を含有する下塗り層を設け、その上に強磁性粉末及び結合剤を含む磁性層を設けた磁気記録媒体であって、前記下塗り層の厚みが０．１〜１μｍで、前記磁性層に含まれる結合剤は、ガラス転移温度が１００〜２００℃であるポリウレタン樹脂を含み、前記磁性層の厚みが２０〜１５０ｎｍで、かつ前記強磁性粉末の平均サイズが２０〜６０ｎｍであることを特徴とする。 【選択図】    なし

docs.title: Magnetic transfer system
docs.abstract: A magnetic transfer system includes magnetic recording medium stocker which holds a plurality of magnetic recording media, a magnetic transfer apparatus which magnetically transfers information represented by a magnetic layer on a master information carrier to the magnetic recording medium by applying a transfer magnetic field to the magnetic recording medium and the master information carrier with the magnetic recording medium and the master information carrier held in close contact with each other, and a conveyor which conveys the magnetic recording medium between the magnetic recording medium holding means and the magnetic transfer means. The magnetic recording medium holding stocker, the magnetic transfer apparatus and the conveyor are formed of material which contains substantially no chlorine, sulfur compound or nitric oxide at least at a part which is brought into contact with the magnetic recording medium.

docs.title: 磁気記録媒体及びその製造方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】ドライエッチングでのプラズマダメージを受けて高温になっても基板、磁性層、及びレジスト層が損傷することなく、また、磁性層のエッチングレートが低下せず、基板自体の温度変化が小さいので、膨張及び収縮によるパターンサイズの変化が少なく、磁気特性が安定した磁気記録媒体、及び該磁気記録媒体を効率よく製造することができる磁気記録媒体の製造方法の提供。 【解決手段】基板の表面にレジスト層及び磁性層をこの順に有する磁気記録媒体における該レジスト層に凹凸パターンを形成する凹凸パターン形成工程と、前記レジスト層に凹凸パターンを形成した磁気記録媒体を冷却する冷却工程と、冷却された前記凹凸パターンをマスクとして、ドライエッチングにより前記磁性層に凹凸形状を形成するドライエッチング工程とを含む磁気記録媒体の製造方法である。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 磁気記録媒体、磁気テープカートリッジおよび磁気記録再生装置
docs.abstract: 非磁性支持体と強磁性粉末を含む磁性層とを有する磁気記録媒体であって、上記強磁性粉末はε－酸化鉄粉末であり、磁気記録媒体の単位面積あたりの垂直方向磁化量Φｍが２５℃の測定温度において５Ｇ・μｍ以上１００Ｇ・μｍ以下であり、１０℃の測定温度におけるΦｍ、２５℃の測定温度におけるΦｍおよび４０℃の測定温度におけるΦｍから求められるΦｍの傾きが－０．２０Ｇ・μｍ／℃以上－０．０３Ｇ・μｍ／℃以下である磁気記録媒体、磁気テープである上記磁気記録媒体を含む磁気テープカートリッジ、ならびに上記磁気記録媒体を含む磁気記録再生装置が提供される。

docs.title: 磁気転写方法および磁気転写装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  磁気転写によって、磁気パターンの位置によ らずに高品位の転写パターンを磁気転写用マスター担体 からスレーブ媒体へ転写する。
【解決手段】  磁極の軸に対称な磁界を有する単一の永 久磁石を磁極の軸をスレーブ媒体面に垂直にスレーブ媒 体を挟んで同極同志を対向させて配置した一対の永久磁 石を、隣接する磁石の極性が異なる様に二対を隣接して 配設し、スレーブ媒体あるいは二対の永久磁石をトラッ ク方向に回転させてスレーブ媒体面のトラック方向に磁 界を印加することにより、あらかじめスレーブ媒体磁化 をトラック方向に初期直流磁化した後、磁気転写用マス ター担体と上記初期直流磁化したスレーブ媒体とを密着 させ、スレーブ媒体面の初期直流磁化方向と逆向きのト ラック方向に転写用磁界を印加させ磁気転写を行う磁気 転写方法。

docs.title: 磁复制用主载体
docs.abstract: 主载体(3)在形成有对应复制信息的图形状凸部的基板(3a)的凸部表面上具有高度为d、磁道方向宽度为w的软磁性层，并且在基板(3a)的凸部之间的凹部上具有与凸部表面上的软磁性层形成磁性结合的软磁性层，所述凸部的磁性层高度d与磁道方向宽度N之比大于0.8，并小于3，且所述凸部的磁性层之间配置另一磁性层，该另一磁性层具有平行于所述凸部磁性层的容易磁化轴和大于所述凸部磁性层的矫顽力的矫顽力，使用所述主载体(3)，在使由该主载体(3)的软磁性层(3b)构成的凸部与磁记录介质2的磁记录面(2b)紧密接触的状态下，通过从主载体(3)的基板(3a)侧施加朝向软磁性层(3b)侧的复制用磁场，来进行磁复制。从而可对垂直磁记录介质进行效果良好的磁复制。

docs.title: 情報処理装置、情報処理システム及びプログラム
docs.abstract: 【課題】指定される装置が実行可能な処理に応じて、指定される処理をその装置と分担して実行することができる情報処理装置、情報処理システム及びプログラムを提供する。 【解決手段】指定情報取得部３０が、実行すべき一連の処理を指定する処理指定情報と、一連の処理のうちの一部の処理を分担して実行すべき装置を指定する装置指定情報と、を含む指定情報を取得する。処理実行部３８が、装置指定情報により指定される装置が実行可能な処理に応じた、処理指定情報により指定される一連の処理のうち自装置で実行すべき処理を実行する。 【選択図】図３

docs.title: 情報処理装置、情報処理システム、及びプログラム
docs.abstract: 【課題】利便性を向上できる情報処理装置、情報処理システム及びプログラムを提供する。 【解決手段】他の、少なくとも一つの情報処理装置、と通信可能に接続されており、当該通信可能に接続された情報処理装置から、利用者の使用の記録を取得し、当該取得した使用の記録に基づいて、利用者に対する情報の提示と、利用者から指示を受け入れるための操作と、の少なくとも一方の態様を変更する情報処理装置である。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 災害情報処理装置、災害情報処理装置の作動方法、災害情報処理装置の作動プログラム、並びに災害情報処理システム
docs.abstract: 発災地域の環境条件に適合した監視カメラの動作の制御を行うことが可能な災害情報処理装置、災害情報処理装置の作動方法、災害情報処理装置の作動プログラム、並びに災害情報処理システムを提供する。有効視界範囲導出部は、監視カメラが撮影した地域の俯瞰画像における有効視界範囲であって、地域の被害状況の把握が可能で、かつ地域の環境条件に応じて変化する有効視界範囲を導出することで取得する。制御信号生成部は、有効視界範囲に応じた監視カメラの制御信号を生成する。制御信号によって、監視カメラの動作が制御される。

docs.title: 概念グラフ処理装置及びプログラム
docs.abstract: 【課題】概念グラフに新規概念を追加する場合にユーザーの負担を解消又は軽減する。 【解決手段】プロセッサは、既存概念グラフ１０に含まれる複数の既存概念１２及び既存概念グラフ１０に含まれない新規概念２０からなる概念群についての説明文群に基づいて、概念群と説明文群に含まれる単語群との間の関係を表す概念単語グラフ２２を生成する。プロセッサは、概念単語グラフ２２に基づいて新規概念を含む拡張概念グラフ３２を生成する。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 情報処理装置及び情報処理プログラム
docs.abstract:
【課題】文字認識の際にユーザが記入した文字及びマークの少なくとも一方を含む領域の認識結果を全て有効とする場合と比較して、ユーザが無効化したい領域内の誤認識を抑制することができる情報処理装置及び情報処理プログラムを提供する。 
【解決手段】情報処理装置１０は、ＣＰＵ１１を備える。ＣＰＵ１１は、ユーザが記入した文字及びマークの少なくとも一方を含む記入済み画像の入力を受け付け、記入済み画像から、ユーザが記入済み画像において無効化したい領域に対して指定した画素塊を抽出し、記入済み画像を文字認識する場合に、抽出した画素塊の少なくとも一部を含む領域については、ユーザが文字認識の認識結果を採用するか否かを確認する第１処理、及び、認識結果の確からしさを表す確信度を現在値よりも低下させる第２処理の少なくとも一方を実行する。 
【選択図】図１

docs.abstract: 【課題】像形成装置等の機器の利用環境に関して、機器が有する機能を連携させて連携機能を実行する場合に連携機能の動作状態を提示する情報処理装置及びプログラムを提供する。 【解決手段】端末装置１６において、画像形成装置複合機：Ｂ６４および、端末装置ＰＣ：Ａ６６が識別される。ユーザが操作子を用いて機器表示画面６２上で繋ぐことにより、連携機能に紐付く画像の表示が制御されると共に、連携機能に使用される各機器の動作状態を示す情報の表示が制御される。 【選択図】図１０

docs.title: 情報処理装置及び情報処理プログラム
docs.abstract: 【課題】入れ物に封入すべき封入物を取り出す場合にあって、取り出した封入物に誤りがあった場合に、その後の取出処理が全て誤りとなってしまうことを防止するようにした情報処理装置を提供する。 【解決手段】情報処理装置の第１の受付手段は、用紙内の第１の情報画像から読み取られた情報であり、入れ物に封入すべき封入物を示している第１の情報を受け付け、第２の受付手段は、前記用紙内の第２の情報画像から読み取られた情報であり、前記入れ物に封入するために取り出された封入物を示している第２の情報を受け付け、検出手段は、前記第１の情報と前記第２の情報が合致していない場合は、封入物の封入の順番を記憶している記憶手段から前記第１の情報と第２の情報の順番の差分を検出し、制御手段は、前記検出手段によって検出された差分に基づいて、封入物を取り出す処理を制御する。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 情報生成装置、情報生成プログラム、情報生成方法、情報読取システム、電子ペン及び記録媒体
docs.abstract: 【課題】出力用紙等の記録媒体上の情報を読み取った機器の動作を制御する制御情報を文書情報に重畳した重畳情報を出力する情報生成装置等を提供する。 【解決手段】符号パターン画像生成装置１０は、出力用紙上の位置或いは出力用紙上に記録される文書画像の記録位置に固有な位置符号を生成する位置符号生成部２０と、出力用紙に記録された情報を読み取った機器の動作を制御する制御符号を生成する制御符号生成部２１と、位置符号を画像情報として二次元配置して形成される符号ブロックの区画に、制御符号を画像情報として配置した符号パターン画像を出力する付加画像情報出力部２４と、外部から入力された文書情報を画像情報に変換し、符号パターン画像を重畳した重畳情報を生成し出力する重畳情報出力部２５とを含む。 【選択図】図９

docs.title: Cultivation device for fruit vegetable plant, and cultivation method for fruit vegetable plant
docs.abstract: Provided are a cultivation device for a fruit vegetable plant and applications thereof, the cultivation device being designed to cultivate fruit vegetable plants of the Solanaceae family or Cucurbitaceae family, the device comprising: a light source that emits artificial light; hydroponic shelves; and a light reflection member. The hydroponic shelves are provided in two or more tiers in a vertical direction in a space in which temperature and humidity are controlled. The light source is disposed on a side of the fruit vegetable plant. The light reflection member is positioned so as to oppose the light source across the fruit vegetable plant.

docs.title: Cultivation methods for fruit and vegetable plants
docs.abstract: [Problem] To provide a cultivation method for fruit and vegetable plants that can be harvested at a higher yield than conventional methods.  [Solution] A method for cultivating fruit and vegetable plants, comprising the step of cultivating fruit and vegetable plants using a flooded hydroponic cultivation method, wherein the roots of the fruit and vegetable plants are not exposed to air during the seedling stage, and after the first flowering is confirmed, at least a portion of the roots are exposed to air during the dark period.  [Selection Diagram] None

docs.title: Plant-cultivating apparatus
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a plant-cultivating apparatus which can uniformly irradiate light on many plants in a simple structure.  <P>SOLUTION: This plant-cultivating apparatus 40 has cultivation units 30a to 30d arranged in a multistory structure, and the cultivation units have cultivation chambers 31a to 31d and light-focusing portions 21a to 21d, respectively. Light-guiding films 10p to 10s are arranged in the cultivation units, respectively. Light-introducing portions 11 are disposed at the longitudinal one ends of the light guide films, and light-outgoing portions 12a to 12c are disposed at the other end portions. Light radiated from a light source 20 is introduced from the light-introducing portions 11 into the light-guiding films and then emit from the light-outgoing portions to irradiate plants.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

docs.title: 植物栽培システム
docs.abstract:

【解決手段】果菜植物を栽培する複数の栽培棚が収容される栽培空間と、各栽培棚で栽培される果菜植物に光を照射する光源と、各栽培棚への光強度を検出する光検出部と、各栽培棚の二酸化炭素濃度を検出する二酸化炭素検出部と、各栽培棚の温湿度を検出する温湿度検出部と、少なくとも、光強度、二酸化炭素濃度、及び温湿度を制御する制御部と、を備え、制御部は、二酸化炭素濃度を変化させて各栽培棚における光合成速度を評価する評価１と、温湿度を変化させて各栽培棚における光合成速度を評価する評価２と、光強度を変化させて各栽培棚における光合成速度を評価する評価３と、を行うことと、評価１～評価３の結果に基づいて、所定の光合成速度に対応する栽培条件を決定することと、決定された栽培条件にて果菜植物を栽培することと、を含む。

docs.title: 图像形成装置
docs.abstract: 本发明公开了一种图像形成装置，该图像形成装置包括：第一单元，其至少包括将静电潜像显影的显影单元和收容显影剂的第一显影剂收容器；图像载体，其保持将由显影单元显影的静电潜像；转印单元，其将显影剂图像转印到记录介质上；定影装置，其将显影剂图像定影到记录介质上；以及图像形成装置主体，第一单元安装在该图像形成装置主体中，图像形成装置主体构造成：可以安装第二单元来代替第一单元，并且当安装有第二单元时，提供循环传送路径以允许围绕第二单元并且朝向转印单元传送其上由定影装置定影有显影剂图像的记录介质，其中第二单元至少包括分别收容有不同颜色显影剂的多个第二显影剂收容器和对应于各颜色的显影单元。

docs.title: 图像形成装置
docs.abstract: 本发明公开了一种图像形成装置，包括：图像载体；显影装置，其向图像载体供应显影剂从而形成显影剂图像；转印单元，其将显影剂图像转印到记录介质上；定影单元，其将对显影剂图像进行定影；传送路径，其将记录介质从供应位置传送到排出口；以及返回路径，其将已定影有显影剂图像的记录介质传送到转印单元上游的位置，以便对利用另一种颜色的显影剂图像进行后续的转印处理和定影处理，其中，传送路径和返回路径设置成围绕显影装置循环，并且包括传送路径与返回路径的汇合点和显影装置的旋转中心的平面设置成沿着记录介质的传送方向在另一平面的上游侧相对于所述另一平面成90°或更宽的角度，其中所述另一平面包括转印位置和显影装置的旋转中心。

docs.title: Cleaning scraper plate, cleaning device, processing cartridge and imaging device
docs.abstract: The invention provides a cleaning scraper plate which has excellent wearing resistance and break resistance even when a component made of a polyurethane rubber that comprises polytetramethylene ether glycol as the main component of a high-polymer polyhydric alcohol component. According to the cleaning scraper plate (342A), a contact corner (3A) which contacts with a cleaned component is composed of a component which contains the polyurethane rubber, wherein the polyurethane rubber is polymerized with the components of: a polyisocyanate component, a low-polymer polyhydric alcohol component with 1,3-propanediol, and a high-polymer polybasic alcohol component which contains more than 50mol% of polytetramethylene ether glycol relative to total high-polymer polybasic alcohol component. The invention further provides a cleaning device with the cleaning scraper plate, a processing cartridge and an imaging device.
