docs.title: 图像形成装置
docs.abstract: 本发明提供了一种图像形成装置，包括环形带状的图像承载部件、环形带状的传送部件、转印部件、第一检测部件、第一偏移校正部件、第一校正控制部、第二检测部件、第二偏移校正部件和第二校正控制部。如果第一检测部件检测到图像承载部件偏移，则第一校正控制部使第一偏移校正部件沿着用于校正图像承载部件的偏移的方向倾斜，从而校正偏移。如果第二检测部件检测到传送部件偏移，则第二校正控制部使第二偏移校正部件沿着用于校正传送部件的偏移的方向倾斜，从而校正偏移。当第一偏移校正部件倾斜时图像承载部件每单位时间沿其宽度方向移动的量被设定为比当第二偏移校正部件倾斜时传送部件每单位时间沿其宽度方向移动的量大。

docs.title: 装订处理装置
docs.abstract: 本发明公开了一种装订处理装置和纸张处理系统，该装订处理装置包括：针装订单元，其形成使用针对纸摞进行装订的针装订部分；无针装订单元，其形成不使用针对纸摞进行装订的无针装订部分；以及多个排出辊，其将已装订纸摞排出。无针装订部分与多个排出辊的中央位置之间的距离等于或长于针装订部分与该中央位置之间的距离。

docs.title: Charged particle generator, charging device, and image forming apparatus
docs.abstract: A charged particle generator includes a first electrode, a second electrode, and an insulating material that is provided between the first electrode and the second electrode. The second electrode has an opening that opens in a first direction in which the first electrode, the insulating material, and the second electrode are arranged. The insulating material has a region limiting space. The region limiting space corresponds to the opening. The region limiting space is continuous with the opening. The region limiting space is a space that opens in a direction in which the region limiting space is oriented toward the opening and that is limited in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction. The first electrode has an anisotropic resistance portion in which a resistance component in the first direction is smaller than a resistance component in the second direction.

docs.title: Image producing method and apparatus, image output method and apparatus, and program
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reflect intention of finish of a user on a print output in applying image processing to image data and printing out the data.  <P>SOLUTION: Re-storage discrimination information F, which is lost in the case of re-storage, is attached to image data S and the resulting data are recorded on a medium M. A user terminal 11 reads the image data S from the medium M, applies composite with a template and image processing to the image data as required, and re-stores the resulting image data S. The re-storage discrimination information F is lost by re-storage. In placing a print order, the user terminal 11 transmits the image data S to a photo shop 2, in which a discrimination section 23A discriminates the presence/absence of the re-storage discrimination information F in the image data S. When the image data S includes the re-storage discrimination information F, since it denotes that no re-storage is applied to the image data S, image processing of correcting the color and the contrast is applied to the image data and the data are printed out. When no re-storage discrimination information F is attached to the image data, since this means that a user 1 processes the image data, the data are printed out without executing the image processing of correcting the color and the contrast.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

docs.title: Data processor, data processing system, data transmission device and program
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To support selection of a content by a user such that processing expected by the user and actually performed processing accord as thoroughly as possible.  <P>SOLUTION: An image forming device acquires a retrieval result including a URL (Uniform Resource Locator) of content data and data attribute information expressing an attribute of the content data of a URL destination thereof, and acquires capability information and state information of an image forming part. The image forming device adds additional information expressing a time spent when image formation is performed based on the content data of the URL destination included in the retrieval result, resolution of printed matter, and an expressible color number or the like to the retrieval result based on the acquired information, and makes it be displayed. The image forming device acquires the content data of the URL destination selected by the user based on display contents thereof, and performs the image formation by use of the acquired content data.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: System and method for machine translation and computer program
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a machine translation system for using a meaning analysis result on the basis of LFG to preferably convert input sentences of translation original language into translation objective language by using the meaning analysis result for the input sentences of the translation objective language to preferably obtain a translated result.  <P>SOLUTION: A plurality of the machine translation systems such as translation service disclosed on a commercially available machine translation system and a web are used. Meaning analysis is performed on the basis of LFG for the translation original language and translated result sentences of each machine translation system respectively, and the translated result sentences are selected on the basis of a degree of similarity of the meaning analysis result with the translation original language. The translated result with the highest quality is acquired by using comparison determination between input sentences written in the translation original language and the translated result sentences written in the translation objective language output from the plurality of the machine translation systems, without directly using the meaning analysis technology to an intermediate language system machine translation system.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: 皮肤用化妆品及化妆品的弹力感的评价方法
docs.abstract: 本发明提供一种皮肤用化妆品及化妆品的弹力感的评价方法，所述皮肤用化妆品含有在主链或侧链具有环状结构的水溶性高分子及具有二甲基或三甲基氨基的水溶性高分子以及在室温下形成覆膜的水溶性高分子，所述化妆品的弹力感的评价方法包括：分别测量未干燥覆膜的面积即第一面积及干燥覆膜的面积即第二面积，并计算第二面积相对于第一面积的比，所述未干燥覆膜的面积即第一面积及干燥覆膜的面积即第二面积由含有待测量弹力感的物质、在室温下形成覆膜的水溶性高分子及着色物质的化妆品形成。

docs.title: Picture compression device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To decrease the picture compression time of a dot picture data and to allow the compression device to cope with high speed processing by providing a double buffer before and after a rearrangement device and an encoder and using them with changeover in a prescribed timing respectively. CONSTITUTION:Dot picture data AD1-ADn are given as dot picture data AD. With switches SW1, SW2 thrown to the position of contacts P2, P3 respectively via a changeover means 12, the data AD1 is written in a buffer 2. With the switches SW1, SW2 thrown to the positions of contacts P1, P4 next, rearrangement device 3 is started, the data AD1 is read and the data AD2 is written in an input buffer 1. With the switches SW3, SW4 thrown respectively to the position of contacts P6, P7 via a changeover means 13, the rearrangement data ND1 from the device 3 is written in an intermediate buffer 6. Then the switches SW3, SW4 are thrown respectively to the position of contacts P5, P8, the encoder 7 is started to read out the rearrangement data ND1 and a data ND2 is written simultaneously in the buffer 5. A compressed picture data GD is stored sequentially into the storage device by the similar processing.

docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve the productivity of image output even when the image output is performed through a personal authentication processing.  <P>SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus includes: an image forming apparatus body 10 for outputting an image on a recording medium; and an authentication terminal 20 separately formed from the image forming apparatus body 10. In this image forming apparatus, the authentication terminal 20 includes: a communication part 21 for performing information transmitting and receiving between it and the image forming apparatus body 10 while being mounted on the image forming apparatus body 10 or in the proximity thereof; an information acquiring part 22 for acquiring information related to a request for image output received by the image forming apparatus body 10 through the communication part 21; a storing part 23 for storing and holding the information acquired by the information acquiring part 22; a displaying part 24 for displaying and outputting the information stored and held by the storing part 23; and an operating part 25 for selecting the request for the image output which is executed by the image forming apparatus body 10 and inputting authentication information necessary for the execution.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Image forming apparatus and program
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image forming apparatus and a program in which a tab sheet is inserted in the same insertion position also under different states not needing the insertion position of the tab sheet to be specified by a user.SOLUTION: An attribute information obtaining part 33 acquires attribute information described in a structured document from a print job stored in a print job storage section 32. An insertion position determination part 34 decides an insertion position that inserts a tab sheet to delimit a printed document based on the attribute information acquired by the attribute information obtaining part 33. A tab sheet setup section 35 sets a color printed on a tab area of the tab sheet based on the language attribute included in the attribute information acquired by the attribute information obtaining part 33. An output control part 36 performs the printing of the tab sheet based on the setting concerning the printing of the tab sheet set by the tab sheet setup section 35, inserts the tab sheet in the insertion position decided by the insertion position determination part 34, and controls an image output part 37 to output the image based on the print job.

docs.title: User interface of recording device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To input the priority order of a tray and inhibit a specific tray from being used and to allow the inhibited tray to be used at the time of automatic form selection and/or automatic tray selection. CONSTITUTION:In priority/inhibited tray setting mode as specified automatic mode, the priority order or inhibition is inputted from an input means 100. A decision means 105 decides priority tray and inhibited tray input information corresponding to the automatic mode. A decision means 106 judges tray input information which does not match the use conditions of a machine as a result of the repetitive input of the order of the priority tray and the specification of all trays as inhibited trays and determined tray input information is stored in a storage means 107. When the inhibited tray is used, an inhibited tray use decision means 111 determines whether or not the inhibited tray that M/C requires can be used or not according to the user input from an inhibited tray use confirmation input means 104. Consequently, the inhibited tray is prevented from automatically be used in the automatic mode.

docs.title: Pressure-responsive particles
docs.abstract: Pressure-responsive particles include pressure-responsive base particles and silica particles, in which the pressure-responsive base particles contain a styrene-based resin that contains styrene and other vinyl monomers as polymerization components and a (meth)acrylic acid ester-based resin that contains at least two kinds of (meth)acrylic acid esters as polymerization components and in which a ratio of a mass of the (meth)acrylic acid esters to a total mass of polymerization components is 90% by mass or more, the pressure-responsive particles have at least two glass transition temperatures, a difference between a lowest glass transition temperature and a highest glass transition temperature is 30°C or higher, and a ratio of a surface coating rate Cs2 by the silica particles after application of the following first stress to a surface coating rate Cs1 by the silica particles before application of stress satisfies a relationship of 0.4 ≤ Cs2/Cs1 ≤ 0.8, first stress: 10 g of the pressure-responsive particles and 90 g of resin-coated ferrite particles are put in a V-shaped mixer with a rotary container having a volume of 0.5 L and rotated at a rotation speed of 40 rpm for 20 minutes at a temperature of 20°C and a relative humidity of 50%.

docs.title: Method of manufacturing cylindrical base body, manufacturing device and cylindrical base body
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a manufacturing method of a cylindrical base body, a manufacturing device and the cylindrical base body manufactured thereby, capable of further speeding up wet honing processing, while maximally holding a rough surface shape of a cylindrical base body surface.  <P>SOLUTION: An injection nozzle is arranged as follows in a wet honing method for roughening the surface by this injection by injecting a surface polishing liquid into the cylindrical base body surface from the injection nozzle : in the first place, a plurality of injection nozzles are arranged in a position for injecting the surface polishing liquid into the cylindrical base body surface, and in the second place, among the plurality of injection nozzles, at least two or more of injection nozzles are arranged on the substantially same horizontal plane vertical to the cylindrical base body axis direction, to thereby provide the manufacturing method of the cylindrical base body, the manufacturing device and the cylindrical base body manufactured thereby, capable of resolving the problem.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: 旋转体的制造方法、感光体的制造方法
docs.abstract: 本发明提供旋转体的制造方法、感光体的制造方法。可抑制因浸渍涂布于基体的涂液的自重而在基体的上部产生的液体垂挂。旋转体的制造方法具有：第1工序，使圆筒状或圆柱状的基体下降而浸渍于涂液，在该基体的上部露出该涂液的状态停止该下降；第2工序，在该第1工序的停止位置以预先设定的时间保持该基体；第3工序，在该第2工序后使该基体进一步下降；和第4工序，在该第3工序后从该涂液中提升该基体。

docs.title: 感光体回転速度検出方法
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  電子写真方式における感光体の回転速度を、 安価なコストでしかも精度よく検出するための感光体回 転速度検出方法を提供すること。
【構成】  電子複写方式に用いられる感光体を具備する 機器であれば当然有している潜像形成手段を利用して、 回転速度検出用の所定の潜像（イ−１）を形成する（１ 回目）。それを消さないままで、正常速度で回転した場 合に感光体が１回転するに要する時間である正常１回転 時間の整数倍の時間後に、再度所定の潜像を形成して （２回目）、合成潜像を形成する。正常速度で回転して いなければ（ロ，ハ）、２回目に形成した潜像は１回目 の潜像とはずれるので、合成潜像は長くなる。合成潜像 の長さを正常速度で回転した時の正常潜像長と比較し、 正常速度であるか否かを検出する。潜像のずれは、正常 １回転時間の整数倍という長い期間における回転量の差 を反映しているので、その値は大きく、検出精度が高 い。また、当然有している潜像形成手段を利用するの で、コストは安い。

docs.title: 静電潜像現像用トナー、その製造方法、及び静電荷像現像用現像剤。
docs.abstract: 【課題】従来の着色剤を含むトナーを用いることなく画像が形成できる静電潜像現像用トナーを提供すること。 【解決手段】互いに隔離された状態で存在し、互いに反応した際に発色する第１成分および第２成分と、前記第１成分および前記第２成分のいずれか一方を含む光硬化性組成物と、を有し、前記光硬化性組成物が未硬化状態の時に発色不可能な状態を維持し、前記光硬化性組成物を硬化させる特定波長の光の照射により前記光硬化性組成物を硬化させることによって、前記発色不可能な状態から発色可能な状態へ不可逆的に制御されることを特徴とする静電潜像現像用トナー。 【選択図】なし

docs.title: ポリエステル樹脂分散物の製造方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】多大なエネルギーを必要とせず、耐水性、乾燥性を損なう事なく良好な塗膜を形成し、また良好な保管性を有するアルキド樹脂水系エマルションの製造方法を提供すること。 【解決手段】多価カルボン酸（誘導体）、モノカルボン酸、及び多価アルコール（誘導体）よりなるポリエステル形成組成物を予備重縮合して得られたポリエステル前駆体を水系媒体中に分散する工程、及び、水系媒体中に分散された該ポリエステル前駆体を更に重縮合する工程を含み、ブレンステッド酸触媒の存在下に、該ポリエステル形成組成物を予備重縮合する、及び／又は、該ポリエステル前駆体を重縮合する、ことを特徴とするポリエステル樹脂分散物の製造方法、及びこの製造方法により得られた樹脂分散物を基材上に塗布乾燥して得られる塗膜。 【選択図】なし

【課題】  無用な現像液の持ち出しを防止し、シート状 感光材料の現像時の搬送方向後端付近の画像に対して現 像むらが生じることなく、画像全域に亘り適正な画像を 得ることができる感光材料処理装置を得る。
【解決手段】  感光材料の後端部に表面張力によって残 留している現像液が垂れ落ちる前に定着液に浸漬させる ために、スクイズローラ対の位置を調整するようにし た。これにより、感光材料の後端近傍が垂れ落ちた現像 液で現像が促進され、その部分の濃度が高くなり、濃度 むらを起こすようなことを防止することができる。

docs.title: Heavy metal trapping method and heavy metal recovering method
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a treatment method for removing heavy metals or valuable metals from wastewater by trapping heavy metals or valuable metals inexpensively and stably in a state friendly to environment from wastewater, waste soil or deposited soil containing heavy metals or valuable metals. SOLUTION: An organic aminocarboxylic acid is added to industrial wastewater, sludge or surplus soil containing heavy metal elements in an equimolar amount or more with respect to the amount of heavy metal elements and, if necessary, water is further added thereto to form an aqueous solution or suspension and organic aminocarboxylic acid decomposing bacteria is allowed to act on the aqueous solution or suspension and a heavy metal-containing precipitate or floating substance generated by the action of the decomposing bacteria is trapped. If an iron salt is allowed to be further present, biodegradation is accelerated to accelerate the removal of heavy metals.

docs.title: Organic aminocarboxylic acid-degradative bacteria pseudomonas editabidus and treatment of waste liquid containing organic aminocarboxylic acid using the same
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a method for treating a waste liquid containing on organic aminocarboxylic acid which is environmentally benign, inexpensive, stable and highly efficient, and to provide organic aminocarboxylic acid-degradative bacteria suitable therefor. CONSTITUTION:The organic aminocarboxylic acid-degradative bacteria Pseudomonas editabidus, and the biodegradative treatment method characterized by mixing or bringing an organic aminocarboxylic acid-contg. waste liquid with or into contact with said bacteria, respectively.

docs.title: 感光材料乾燥方法及び装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  比較的低温のヒートローラを用いて、高画質 かつ寸度の安定した乾燥を効率よく行う感光材料乾燥方 法及び装置を得る。
【構成】  乾燥室４５Ａ内には、２本のヒートローラ５ ０、５０が備えられ、感光材料１４が巻掛けられてい る。この巻掛け角度、すなわち、感光材料１４の巻掛開 始点（Ｂ点及びＤ点））から巻掛終了点（Ｃ点及びＥ 点）までの角度θは、略９０°とされている。この角度 θは、ヒートローラ５０の外径と回転速度とに基づいて 所定の巻掛け時間が得られるように設定され、さらに、 この巻掛け時間とヒートローラ５０の外周温度とに基づ く値が感光材料１４へ与えられる熱量となる。ヒートロ ーラ５０の軸心部には、ヒートローラ５０の外周部を加 熱する熱源５６が配設されている。この熱源５６によっ て、ヒートローラ５０の外周が７０℃に加熱され、感光 材料１４がこの外周面に接触して加熱される。

docs.title: Photosensitive material processing device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To speed up bleach-fix processing and to prevent the deterioration of a bleach-fixer. CONSTITUTION:A bleach-fixing tank 3 is internally divided to a 1st part P1 and a 2nd part P2. An anode is installed into the 1st part P1 on the entrance side of the photosensitive material S and a cathode is installed into the 2nd part P2 on the photosensitive material S ejection side. These electrodes are energized during the processing of the photosensitive material and are de- energized at the time of the non-processing.

docs.title: 液体又は気体の浄化方法
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  環境汚染物質、悪臭発生物質を含む液体また は気体を、消費エネルギーが小さく、安価で且つ安定に 処理できる簡易な液体または気体の浄化処理を成し遂げ ること。
【解決手段】  被処理液体又は被処理気体を、電磁波の 照射によって実質的に無菌状態が保持された活性炭に、 酸素原子供給物質存在下で接触させる液体または気体の 浄化方法。

docs.title: Method and device for joining beltlike metal plates
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent defective welding at the time of performing butt welding on end faces cut with a gradient in the cross direction of preceding and succeed ing beltlike metal plates by cutting both plates separately and rolling a joined part to suppress the occurrence of burrs at the time of cutting. CONSTITUTION:The preceding and succeeding beltlike metal plates 36 and 38 are fixed by outlet side and inlet side clamps 26 and 22 respectively. After the tip of the plate 36 is cut diagonally with a cutting unit 32 inclined by >=5 deg., a joining unit 14 is then slightly moved in the right direction and an end of the plate 38 is cut at the same angle as before by the unit 32. The unit 14 is then moved in the right direction and a welding unit 34 is arranged above the cut ends of the plates 36 and 38 and in this state, the clamps 26 and 22 are operated and the cut parts of the plates 36 and 38 are superposed (or abut ted) slightly on each other and fixed. Afterward, the plates 36 and 38 are welded and joined together by the unit 34 and the unit 14 is moved to the left direction and a rolling unit 30 is arranged above the joined part 48 to roll the joined part 48.

docs.title: Exposure device for copying machine
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To make the distribution of the light quantity on the surface of a photoreceptor uniform with a simple adjustment, by providing plural photodetectors, which change the output in accordance with the light quantity from a light source, near the photoreceptor and providing a means for the adjustment of the inclination to the optical axis. CONSTITUTION:A slit member 11 is provided near a photoreceoptor 8, and the light from a light source is condensed by this slit member and is projected to the surface of the photoreceptor. An aperture card holding part 5 is movable, and the light from a light source device 4 scans a microfilm on the holding part 5 in every line. Plural photodetectors 12 which generate outputs corresponding to the light quantity are arranged in the axial direction of the photosensitive drum above the surface of the photoreceptor 8 and in part where these phtotodetectors 12 have no influence upon the copying operation of a slit member 11 provided adjacently to them. Thus, a high-precision distribution of the light quantity is obtained, and the adjusting work is performed easily in a short time.

docs.title: Exposure device of copying machine
docs.abstract:
PURPOSE: Not only to decrease the light source capacity but also to reduce the oscillatory influence at the time of scanning, by controlling the light emission of a flash lamp for exposing an original, in accordance with rotation of the scanning mirror.  
     CONSTITUTION: A reflected ray from an original 10 according to irradiation by the flash lamp 2 forms an image on the sensitive body through the scanning mirror 3 and the slit 11. Rotation of this scanning mirror 3 is detected by the slit disk 5 and the light emission time detector 6, and the lighting period of time of the lamp 2 is controlled synchronously with rotation of the mirror 4 in accordance with the time when the image formation of the sensitive body 12 by the slit 11 is moved from the point A to B through the waveform shaping circuit 7 of a monostable multivibrator, etc., the control circuit 8 and the driving circuit 9. In this way, the lamp 2 is turned off when it is not required, a necessary exposure effect can be obtained by the light source of small capacity, and the capacity of the light source can be reduced. Moreover, since the light emission time is short, generation of image blur, etc. caused by vibration of the mirror 3 is lowered. 
     COPYRIGHT: (C)1981,JPO&Japio

docs.title: Permanent magnet stator coreless motor - has rotor of thin coils with (in) effective parts outside stator magnetic field
docs.abstract: The coreless motor is intended for providing a low intertia moment with a high efficiency and long life. Its rotor is composed of thin overlapping coils located at right angles to the magnetic field of the permanent magnets forming the stator. Each coil has an effective part (1a, 1c) and a ineffective part (1b, 1d). The ineffective parts are bent at right angles to the effective parts and lie outside the permanent magnets (3) strong magnetic field. The coils are made from flat loops with their effective parts lying radially. The loops may be circular or rectangular.

docs.title: Toroidal coil motor
docs.abstract: A toroidal coil motor characterized by the provision of an annular iron core in which laminate-fixing holes whose number is the least common multiple with respect to the number of magnetic poles and the number of toroidal coils are provided symmetrically in a direction of the circumference of the annular iron core.

docs.title: Image recording device
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image recording device suited for using a recording material incapable of neglecting the humidity dependency from its performance and capable of miniaturizing the size. SOLUTION: This image recording device forming a recording image corresponding to image data on a thermosensitive recording material is characterized in retaining, at least, a hermetically closable magazine storing the thermosensitive recording material and a waiting passage separate from a major carrier passage for temporarily waiting the thermosensitive recording material taken out from the magazine. It is preferable that this device is provided with a switch means between the major carrier passage and the waiting passage also served as a takeout means for taking out the thermosensitive recording material from the magazine.

docs.title: Operating machine such as copy machine
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To inform operating information corresponding to the skill of the operator, by providing a device selecting the content of information with a device informing the operating procedure and mechanical state by means of voice and characters. CONSTITUTION:On an operating panel 1 of a copy machine, selecting switches 17a and 17b selecting the degree of mastered skill of the 1st and middle class skill, are arranged with start switches 11a-11c. A control circuit 3 receives various set signals set on the panel 1 and also receives a detection signal from a detector 5, a copy forming instruction signal is transmitted to a copy machine driving device 2, an audio generating signal is transmitted to an audio output circuit 4 and a display signal is transmitted to the panel 1. Thus, since speaking suitable for the 1st or middle class is achieved by depressing either one of the switches 17a and 17b, the operation suitable for the mastered skill of the operator is made.

docs.title: Control device for timing of copying machine
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To start a copying mechanism in an early time and to reduce the time for discharging the 1st copy by putting the copying mechanism into a stable operation on the basis of the point of the time when an original is detected at the original insertion plate of a path for circulating and conveying the original. CONSTITUTION:An original plate sensor 10 is provided to an original insertion plate 1 of a path for circulating and conveying an original and a copying mechanism enters stable operation on the basis of the point of the time when the original is detected by such sensor 10. Since the timing is controlled on the basis of the period earlier than the point of the time when the original is detected by a feed sensor 7, etc. and therefore the time for discharging the 1st copy is shortened by starting the copying mechanism in the early period without the need for stopping temporarily the conveyance of the original, etc.

docs.title: Method for inputting signal to optical modulator
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To decrease the influence of tertiary higher harmonic destortions by including the high-frequency signals which are not adjacent to each other in the same group when the plural high-frequency signals inputted to an optical modulator are arranged in order of the magnitude of frequencies. CONSTITUTION:Only the high-frequency signals which are not adjacent to each other are included in the same group when the plural high-frequency signals inputted to the optical modulator 60 are arranged in order of the magnitude of the frequencies. An oscillation circuit 62A which outputs the signal of the frequency f1 and an oscillation circuit 62B which oscillates the signal of the frequency f2 are combined and the signals outputted from the respective oscillation circuits 62A, 62B are mixed by a combiner 68AB. A combiner 68CD mixes the signals of the frequencies f1, f2 and a combiner 68 EF mixes the signals of the frequencies f3, f7. A combiner 68GH mixes the signals of the frequencies f4, f8. The influence of an intermodulation disturbance, more particularly the influence of the tertiary distortion intermodulation product is prevented by using an amplifier circuit of the small max. output power.

docs.title: 情報処理装置、情報処理システム及び情報処理プログラム
docs.abstract: 【課題】ユーザーが用いる端末を介さずに、印刷対象の文書を文書記憶装置から画像処理装置に送信するようにした情報処理装置を提供する。 【解決手段】情報処理装置の受付手段は、印刷対象となる文書の格納場所を示す第１の情報を受け付け、送信手段は、第１の情報を用いて認可リクエストを生成し、該認可リクエストに対応する第２の情報を生成し、該認可リクエストと該第２の情報を該第１の情報の送信者が用いる端末に送信し、第２の受付手段は、認可リクエストに対応する認可コードを受け付け、制御手段は、認可コードを用いてアクセストークンを取得し、アクセストークンと第２の情報と第１の情報を対応させて記憶させるように制御し、第２の送信手段は、画像処理装置から第２の情報を受け付けた場合は、該第２の情報に対応するアクセストークンと格納場所を示す情報を用いて、格納場所にある文書を取得し、該文書を該画像処理装置に送信する。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 情報処理装置、および情報処理方法、並びにコンピュータ・プログラム
docs.abstract: 【課題】  表示入力デバイス上に紙媒体を置いて、紙媒体に対するデータ記録およびディスプレイを用いた電子データの利用をストレスなく実行可能としたシステムを提供する。 【解決手段】  表示入力デバイス上に載置された紙媒体の位置を検出し、検出した表示入力デバイス上の紙媒体の位置に対応する表示情報を均一色の表示データとする制御を実行する。また、紙媒体の位置の外周部に、コマンド入力、あるいはデータ呼び出し用の入力部の表示処理を実行する。本構成により、ディスプレイ上に紙書類を置いて、紙書類に対してペンなどの筆記具によって文字、図面などを記録する場合の見づらさが改善され、また入力部の指定による関係データの表示が可能であり、ユーザに対して良好な作業環境を提供することが可能となる。 【選択図】  図１

docs.title: Ic and wireless ic tag
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wireless IC tag which has radiation shielding effect and has less reduction in antenna gain.  <P>SOLUTION: In a wireless IC tag 10 whereon an IC 12 is integrally mounted with a miniaturized antenna 40, a radiation shielding material 22 covers an IC (IC chip) alone. Therefore, the area of the miniaturized antenna 40 covered with the radiation shielding material 22 is extremely small, thus minimizing reduction in antenna gain of the miniaturized antenna 40 constituting the wireless IC tag 10. The wireless IC tag has radiation shielding effect.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: Wireless power transmission antenna, power transmission antenna, power reception antenna, and wireless power transmission apparatus
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wireless power transmission antenna, power transmission antenna, power reception antenna, and wireless power transmission apparatus, capable of lowering a resonance frequency more than when a resonance capacitor by stubbing is used.SOLUTION: The wireless power transmission antenna (100, 500) includes: a loop part (102, 502) which has one end and the other end and is formed into a loop shape; a first flat plate (104a, 504a) connected with the one end; and a second flat plate (104b, 504b) disposed to oppose to the first flat plate (104a, 504a).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

docs.title: Cpu bus arbitration system
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To make request processing uniform while fixing the priority levels of respective processors of a single-bus coupling type multiprocessor system. CONSTITUTION:A latch circuit 12 in a CPU bus arbitrating circuit 11 samples request signals 100, 102, and 104 from processors 20 and 30 with a latch signal 122 with a clock period. Once the request signals are latched, their information is stored in a flag storage memory 13 and a request flag is set. At this point of time, the latch signal 122 is inhibited. An access priority determining circuit 14 sends out an access priority signal 114 to a timing generating circuit 15 according to the priority. The timing generating circuit 15 sends out a process request 128 to a memory part 18 and also sends out an acknowledgement signal 126 to the processor. Consequently, information is transferred between the processor and a storage device 10 as a common resource. When information transfer is completed as to all request flags, the latch signal 122 is generated again and the latch circuit 12 starts sampling request signals.

docs.title: Memory card management system for writing data with usage and recording codes made significant
docs.abstract: In an IC memory card control system including an IC memory card and an IC memory card control apparatus to which the IC memory card is detachably mounted to store therein management information as well as data, the management area of the IC memory card is provided with an identification area into which are written an occupation code indicative of recording of the data in the data area and a recording code indicative of an abnormal recording of the data in the data area. The IC memory card control apparatus provides such a control that when writing the data into the data area, prior to data writing, the occupation code and the recording code are written into the identification area in their significant states, and after having completed the data writing the recording code is absolved from the significant state.

docs.title: 筆記情報処理装置及びプログラム
docs.abstract: 【課題】電子文書が印刷された媒体に期限内に行われた筆記を、期限を過ぎて行われた筆記と区別して電子文書に関連付ける。 【解決手段】識別情報サーバ３０では、受信部３１が、媒体の識別情報と筆記を電子化した筆跡情報と筆記に用いたデジタルペンのペンＩＤとを受信し、媒体管理部３２が、筆記の日時が媒体の識別情報に対応付けられた有効期限内かどうかを判定し、筆跡情報分割部３５が、その判定結果に基づいて筆跡情報を、有効期限内の筆記に関する有効筆跡情報と、有効期限以降の筆記に関する無効筆跡情報とに分割し、送信部３９が、有効筆跡情報と無効筆跡情報とを別々に管理されるように文書サーバに送信する。その後、文書サーバから筆跡情報登録完了報告があると、無効筆跡情報を登録していれば、アラート設定部３６がアラートを設定して、アラートがデジタルペンに送信される。 【選択図】図４

docs.title: Calculating device
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a calculating device with a Bayesian network model mounted capable of easily correcting a model so as to cope with change when the change occurs in the trend of learning data.  <P>SOLUTION: The calculating device stores a Bayesian network 20 including nodes 22 indicating a probability variable and a conditional probability indicating a dependence relation between nodes, and at least one learning data table 30 in which a value of learning data to be input to the Bayesian network 20 is associated with a value of a probability variable indicated by at least one node about the node in the Bayesian network 20, updates the learning data table 30, acquires learning data to be input to the Bayesian network 20, and calculates certainty indicated by a node having a dependence relation to a node indicating the probability variable at least on the basis of the value of the probability variable corresponding to the value of the learning data acquired by an acquisition means.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: シート体用搬送装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】幅寸法の異なる種々のシート体を、損傷させる ことなく円滑に搬送するとともに、構成の簡素化を図る ことを可能にする。
【解決手段】ガイド機構７２は、蓄積性蛍光体シートＳ の搬送方向に交差する幅方向に延在する軸部材８２と、 前記蓄積性蛍光体シートＳに接触するとともに、前記軸 部材８２に対して軸方向に移動可能に設けられる第１お よび第２可動ローラ部材８４ａ、８４ｂと、該蓄積性蛍 光体シートＳの幅寸法に応じて、前記第１および第２可 動ローラ部材８４ａ、８４ｂを前記軸方向に移動させる 駆動機構８６とを備える。

docs.title: シート体搬送機構
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】寸法の異なる種々のシート体を片側基準で高精 度に搬送するとともに、構成を有効に簡素化することを 可能にする。
【解決手段】シート体搬送機構１０は、蓄積性蛍光体シ ート３２を挟持して搬送するローラ対９０を備えるとと もに、このローラ対９０の左右のニップ圧がそれぞれ異 なる値に設定されている。このため、寸法の異なる蓄積 性蛍光体シート３２に作用するニップ圧が、該蓄積性蛍 光体シート３２の左右で不均一になることがなく、高精 度な搬送処理が遂行される。

docs.title: シート搬送装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】ジャムしたシートの確認を確実にでき、しかも 確実にジャム処理を行うことができるシート搬送装置を 提供する。
【解決手段】内側扉部３および外側扉部４を有する二重 扉構造の開閉扉２を備え、この開閉扉２と装置本体１と の間に第１のシート搬送路５を設けると共に、前記内側 扉部３と外側扉部４の間に第２のシート搬送路６を設け てなるシート搬送装置であって、開閉扉２の開放時に、 自動的に内側扉部３と外側扉部４とが離間せしめられる 間隔作成手段７ａを設ける。更に、両扉部の開放間隔が 調整せしめられる間隔調整手段７ｂを設ける。また、内 側扉部３と外側扉部４間のロック解除手段８を複数箇所 に設け、いずれのロック解除手段８によってもロックを 解除可能に構成する。さらに、ロック解除手段８の操作 部８ａの設置方向を表示する表示部９を設ける。

docs.title: 多軸ターレット式ウエブ巻取装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】装置の大型化を抑制しながら、合わせて巻取ロ ールの大径化や広幅化に対応することができる。
【解決手段】作業床７０上に対向する支持フレーム７ ６、７７に、面板７２、７３の外周部を旋回軸受７４、 ７５を介して支持する面板支持機構、作業床７０下に配 設されて前記面板支持機構の面板７２、７３を回転駆動 する面板駆動部、面板支持機構の面板７２、７３に面板 駆動部からの動力を伝達する動力伝達機構から構成され る。

docs.title: シート供給装置及びこれを用いる画像処理装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】揺動する積載台を持つシート供給装置におい て、送り手段へのシート突入位置の変動を少なくする。
【解決手段】シート供給トレイ１８にはシートを多数積 載する積載台５６が揺動自在に設けられている。この積 載台５６の上部に供給ヘッド２０が設けられ、この供給 ヘッド２０は、ナジャーロール６４、フィードロール６ ６及びリタードロール６８とから構成され、ナジャーロ ール６４の回転により積載台５６のシートがフィードロ ール６６とリタードロール６８とのニップ部８０へ押出 される。ナジャーロール６４のシート押出し位置は位置 検出手段８６により検出される。積載台５６のシート残 量が少なくなると、ナジャーロール６４から押出される シートの角度が上昇するが、ナジャーロール６４のシー ト押出し位置が積載台５６のシート残量に応じて制御さ れ、ナジャーロール６４から押出されたシートは適正範 囲内でリタードロール６８に突き当てることができる。

docs.title: シート材給送装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  シート材に走行負荷を与えずにシートガイド 部材を適切に位置決めできる安価なシート材給送装置を 提供する。
【解決手段】  シート材収容部でのシート材の収容位置 を規制するガイド機構の構成として、ガイドシャフト４ にサイドガイド５を摺動可能に係止するとともに、ガイ ドシャフト４の一端４ａを押し戻し用の圧縮コイルバネ １２を介してスラスト軸受部材９に嵌合した。そして、 シート材１３の端部に向けてサイドガイド５を摺動させ た際に、その摺動抵抗によって圧縮コイルバネ１２を圧 縮変形させ、シート材１３の端部にサイドガイド５を押 し付けて係止した際には、圧縮コイルバネ１２の反力で スライドシャフト４と一緒にサイドガイド５を押し戻 し、これによってシート材１３の端部とサイドガイド５ との間に微小ギャップｇを確保するようにした。

docs.title: シート部材供給装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  受像材料等のシート部材を正確な姿勢で供給 できるシート部材供給装置を得る。
【解決手段】  受像材料４２を吸着して搬送する吸盤１ ７２の前方には、受像材料４２を挟持した状態で回転し て送り出す搬送ローラ２５６、２５８が配置されてお り、吸盤１７２によって搬送された受像材料４２の先端 部が搬送ローラ２５６、２５８へ突き当てられる。ここ で、吸盤１７２は弾性変形可能であり、また、吸盤１７ ２による受像材料４２の搬送速度は搬送ローラ２５６の 回転周速度よりも速い。このため受像材料４２の姿勢が ずれて、先端部の幅方向一端が幅方向他端よりも先に搬 送ローラ２５６、２５８へ突き当たった場合には、幅方 向一端が搬送ローラ２５６、２５８の間へ挟み込まれる 前に、搬送ローラ２５６からの反力によって吸盤１７２ が弾性変形して、受像材料４２の姿勢を修正する。

docs.title: シート搬送装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  シートのジャム処理時における弾性ゲート部 材の変形を防止し得るシート搬送装置を提供する。
【解決手段】  弾性ゲート部材５を有する搬送路切り替 え部６を備え、この搬送路切り替え部６を露出させるべ く、シートガイド７の少なくとも一部が通路内部に滞留 したシート１０を除去処理可能な方向に移動する可動シ ートガイド７ａとなっているシート搬送装置であって、 可動シートガイド７ａの少なくとも弾性ゲート部材５と 対向する部分を固定ガイド部８とする。また、弾性ゲー ト部材５を回転支持部材５ａにて回転可能に支持した。 さらに、可動シートガイド７ａの開放時に、可動シート ガイド７ａに連動して弾性ゲート部材５をジャム処理時 のシート１０と接触しない位置まで待避させる。

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】  現像剤中の劣化したトナーを減らすことができる画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】  像保持体と、像保持体の表面を帯電させる帯電器と、露光器と、現像器とを備え、帯電器が、像保持体の表面のうち、予め決められた端部を除いた本体部を帯電させる主帯電部と、端部を、主帯電部とは異なる帯電電位に帯電させる副帯電部とを備えたものであり、現像器が、像保持体に面した現像領域へと搬送する現像ロールと、トナー供給口よりも下流側で現像剤を表面に保持する搬送体と、搬送体とは電位差を有する、この電位差で、搬送体によって搬送中の現像剤から上記トナーを吸着する吸着体とを備えた。 【選択図】        図２

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】  現像剤中の劣化したトナーを減らすことができる画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】  潜像形成部によって潜像が形成される面の広がる方向に像保持体と並んだ、表面の電位が像保持体の表面電位とは独立な独立部材と、独立部材の表面を帯電させる帯電器とを備え、現像器が、像保持体および独立部材の双方に隣り合った、現像剤を像保持体に面した現像領域および独立部材に面した対向領域へと搬送する現像ロールと、現像ロールに隣り合い現像ロールの回転軸に沿って延びた、独立部材から遠い方から独立部材に近づく方へと向かう第１方向に、収容した現像剤を搬送する第１収容部と、第１収容部に隣接し第１収容部に並んで延びた、両端に、第１収容部との間で現像剤が移動する移動口が設けられた、第１方向とは逆の第２方向に、収容した現像剤を搬送する第２収容部と、トナー供給口を通じて第２収容部へトナーを供給するトナー供給部とを備えた。 【選択図】        図２

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】  接触帯電装置を備える現像同時クリーニング方式の画像形成装置において、接触帯電装置への残留トナーの付着を低減し、カブリやスジ等の画質欠陥の発生を抑制する。 【解決手段】  導電性支持体及び感光層を有する電子写真感光体７と、感光体７を所定の極性に帯電させる接触帯電装置８と、感光体７表面に静電潜像を形成する露光装置１０と、静電潜像を、感光体７と逆極性に帯電したトナーにより現像してトナー像を形成する現像装置１１と、転写装置１２と、転写後の残留トナーを接触帯電装置８の極性と同極性に帯電させるトナー帯電装置１７と、を備え、現像装置１１は、残留トナーを回収することが可能であり、感光層は、６００〜９００ｎｍの波長域での分光吸収スペクトルにおいて、８１０〜８３９ｎｍの範囲に最大ピーク波長を有するヒドロキシガリウムフタロシアニンを含有している画像形成装置。 【選択図】  図３

docs.title: 現像装置及びこれを用いた画像形成装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】一成分現像剤のトナーを担持搬送する現像剤担持体の表面に着目し、現像剤担持体での現像履歴によるゴーストの発生を抑制した現像装置及びこれを用いた画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】静電潜像が担持される像担持体１に対向して開口し且つトナーが収容可能な現像ハウジング２と、現像ハウジング２の開口に面して配設され且つ外周面にてトナーが担持搬送可能な現像剤担持体３とを備え、現像剤担持体３は、算術平均粗さ（Ｒａ）が１．５μｍ以上であり、かつ、算術平均傾斜（Δａ）が０．１以上０．４以下の表面粗さを具備する。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】最小限の調整時間で所定の画像濃度が得られる 制御手段を備えた画像形成装置を提供することを目的と する。
【解決手段】二成分現像剤を保持した現像装置３を用い て記録媒体上に定着トナー像からなる画像を形成する画 像形成装置において、現像剤のトナー濃度を測定するト ナー濃度測定手段と、基準電位の基準トナー像の濃度を 測定するトナー像濃度測定手段と、基準トナー像の濃度 の、所定の目標濃度からの偏差に応じて現像剤中のトナ ー濃度を増減させるトナー濃度調整手段とを備え、偏差 と、現像剤中のトナー濃度の濃度領域内に応じて選択さ れた変換係数との双方に基づいて、現像装置内のトナー を増減させる。

docs.title: 画像形成装置
docs.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  像担持体上の潜像にトナーを選択的に付着し て可視像とした後、記録材に転写する画像形成装置にお いて、転写効率を向上して廃棄トナーの発生量を少なく するとともに、長期にわたり安定した画質を得る。
【解決手段】  像担持体１と対向して現像装置４を配設 し、該現像装置内に収容されるトナーに、これより小粒 径の微粒子を外添する。このとき、微粒子の外添被覆率 が１００％以上のトナー粒子を、現像装置内のトナー中 に３wt% 以上、３０wt% 以下含ませるように調整する。 また、像担持体１と現像装置４との間にはＡＣ電界を作 用させる。これにより、トナーが像担持体１と現像装置 ４との間で往復運動し、像担持体１と繰り返し接触する ため、像担持体上で微粒子がならされほぼ均一に分散付 着する。

docs.title: 画像形成装置、画像形成カートリッジ、および現像カートリッジ
docs.abstract: 【課題】本発明は、トナーの無駄や生産性の低下の無い画像形成装置、および前記画像形成装置に装着される画像形成カートリッジおよび現像カートリッジの提供。 【解決手段】転写画像形成領域１６Ａの外側にトナー消費画像が形成される感光体ドラム１６と、感光体ドラム１６の表面に形成された潜像をトナーで現像して前記転写トナー画像および前記トナー消費画像とする現像ユニット７４と、感光体ドラム１６の表面に形成されたトナー消費画像を除去してトナーを回収するトナー回収ブレード２０Ｂとを備え、前記現像ユニット７４は、現像ローラ１２６とトナーを含有する現像剤を現像ローラ１２６に沿って搬送して現像ローラ１２６にトナーを付着させる攪拌搬送オーガ１１６、１２０を有し、トナー消費画像は、感光体ドラム１６におけるトナーまたは現像剤の搬送方向の下流側の領域に形成される画像形成装置。 【選択図】図５

docs.title: 画像形成装置および画像形成装置のクリーニング方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】感光体表面を磨耗することなく放電生成物を長期わたって継続的に除去することが可能であり、これによって感光体のロングライフ化と放電生成物除去による画像白抜け防止を両立できる画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】感光体ドラムの側周に、感光体ドラムの回転方向Ａに沿って、像担持面に静電潜像を形成する帯電装置および露光装置、この静電潜像をトナーで現像して像担持面にトナー像を形成する現像装置、およびトナー像を転写媒体に転写する転写ロールがこの順に配置された画像形成装置において、転写ロールと帯電手段との間には、像担持面に当接されると共に感光体ドラムの回転方向Ａを横切る方向に延設された複数の溝ｄを備えたトナー保持面１６ａを有する放電生成物除去手段が配置されていることを特徴としている。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 放射線画像検出器及びその製造方法、並びに放射線画像検出器を用いた放射線撮影システム
docs.abstract: 【課題】被写体の放射線位相イメージングにおける位相情報の精度を高める放射線画像検出器を提供する。 【解決手段】通過する放射線によって周期的強度分布を含む放射線像を形成する放射線遮蔽部３１ｂと、放射線を検出して電荷を蓄積する複数の画素４０が行列状に配列されてなる受像部４１と、受像部４１を支持する支持体３１ａとを、備え、受像部４１によって放射線像を検出し、該放射線像に含まれる周期的強度分布に基づく周期パターンを含む画像データを生成する放射線画像検出器３０であって、放射線遮蔽部３１ｂは、支持体３１ａに形成されている放射線画像検出器３０。 【選択図】図５

docs.title: 放射線画像撮影装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】撮影対象者による不快感を低減することができると共に、撮影時における使い勝手を向上させることのできる放射線画像撮影装置を得る。 【解決手段】放射線が照射されることにより光を発生するシンチレータ８、当該シンチレータ８で発生した光を受光することにより電荷が発生する有機光電変換材料を含んで構成されたセンサ部、および当該センサ部で発生された電荷を読み出すための薄膜トランジスタが形成されたＴＦＴ基板３０を有する放射線検出器２０が収容された放射線検出ユニット４２を、少なくとも放射線検出器２０により放射線画像の撮影を行う際に放射線Ｘの照射方向に対して、放射線検出器２０の動作を制御する制御部５０が収容された制御ユニット４３に重ならないように当該制御ユニット４３の側方に位置され、かつ厚さを制御ユニット４３に比較して薄くする。 【選択図】図１３

docs.title: 放射線画像検出器、放射線画像撮像装置、及び放射線画像撮像システム
docs.abstract: 【課題】３画素のビニング処理の前後で６方向の解像度を維持した放射線画像検出器を提供する。 【解決手段】放射線検出器４２の画素領域が六角形状の複数の画素２０のうち、各々が３画素からなる複数の画素群について、放射線検出器４２内で３画素分の電荷をまとめて読み取り、これら３画素の電荷信号を合成して、チャージアンプで順次、積分する。さらに、特定の画素群に対しては、その画素群を構成する３画素のうち、２画素分の電荷信号と、残りの１画素分の電荷信号とを、同一のチャージアンプの積分タイミングをずらして加算する。これにより、３画素のビニング処理を行う。 【選択図】図２

docs.title: 放射線撮影装置、及び、そのプログラム
docs.abstract: 【課題】  胸部に現れる異常陰影などの検出を高性能に行う。 【解決手段】  複数の線源位置から被写体５をＸ線撮影するトモシンセシス撮影を行う際に、被写体５の心拍位相を検出し、複数の各線源位置において、検出された心拍位相が同一位相のときに、被写体５をＸ線撮影する。 【選択図】          図２

docs.title: 放射線撮影システム及び放射線撮影方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】被写体の位相イメージングを行う放射線撮影システム及び放射線撮影方法において、イメージングの精度向上を図る。 【解決手段】放射線撮影システム１０は、Ｘ線源１１と、第１の透過型格子３１と、第２の透過型格子３２と、第２の透過型格子３２を移動させる走査機構３３と、第１及び第２の透過型格子３１，３２を透過したＸ線を検出するフラットパネル検出器３０と、フラットパネル検出器３０で取得される複数の画像に基づき、被写体の位相コントラスト画像を生成する演算処理部２２と、を備え、演算処理部２２は、屈折角の分布像を構成する各画素の画素値に対して、その画素に対応したフラットパネル検出器３０の画素４０の、第２の透過型格子３２の走査方向に関する、入射放射線に対しての実効幅Ｄ´に応じた感度補正を行い、補正された屈折角の分布像に基づいて位相コントラスト画像を生成する。 【選択図】図１０

docs.title: 放射線撮影装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】撮影後に最適な照射線量を簡単かつ迅速に確認することを可能とする。 【解決手段】Ｘ線画像検出装置は、撮像部、線量検出部、照射判定部、累積線量判定部、照射時間算出部を有する。線量検出部は、撮像部に入射するＸ線の線量を検出する。照射判定部は、線量検出部により検出される線量に基づいて、回診車からのＸ線の照射開始を判定する。累積線量判定部は、線量検出部により検出される線量を積算して累積線量を周期的に算出し、この累積線量が適正値に達する時刻ｔ１を判定する。照射時間算出部は、照射判定部によりＸ線照射が開始されたと判定された時刻ｔ０から、累積線量判定部により判定された時刻ｔ１までの適正照射時間Ｔ１を算出する。適正照射時間Ｔ１は、コンソールに送信され、コンソールの表示部に表示される。 【選択図】図８

docs.title: 放射線画像撮影装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】リセット動作に起因して発生する放射線画像の段差を補正することができる放射線画像撮影装置を提供する。 【解決手段】マトリクス状に設けられた複数の画素２０に蓄積された電荷を取り出して除去するリセット動作を、列方向とは交差する行方向に配列された画素２０のライン毎に繰り返し行い、放射線の照射開始が検出された際にリセット動作を停止し、放射線の照射終了後に、生成された画像情報における、リセット動作を停止した際にリセット動作が行われていた画素２０のラインの画像情報を、列方向に隣接する画素２０のラインの画像情報から補間する。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 放射線画像検出装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】  漏れ電荷による残像の発生を低減する。 【解決手段】  放射線検出装置１は、放射線画像情報を担持した電磁波を透過する上部平面電極２１と、電磁波の照射により電荷を発生する電荷発生層２２と、電荷発生層２２において発生した電荷を収集する複数の分割電極２３とを有している。この分割電極２３は、上部平面電極２１に対して傾いている傾斜電極面２３ｂを備えている。 【選択図】  図１

docs.title: Printing system, printing control device, and printing control program
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a printing system, a printing control device, and a printing control program for easily printing print data with an arbitrary printout destination set thereto by mutual cooperation between printing control devices, from a desired printer on a communication network.  <P>SOLUTION: A printer B receiving instructions to print the print data related to a print request makes a request to transfer the print data requested by a print request terminal, to a print server B. The print server B acquires the print data from a print server A and transfers the image data to the printer B for list display.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Print control device and print control system
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a print control device and a print control system capable of shortening a processing time required by a print device from the start of receiving data required for printout to the completion of printing based on the data as compared to the case that the print device performs print processing after receiving the data required for the printout which is generated by a device at a requesting side based on the data received from a database.  <P>SOLUTION: A print server 1 includes: a job acceptance means 10A for accepting a variable job file from a terminal device 4; a database query cursor management means 10D for specifying a record to obtain data from the database 2 based on the variable job file; a variable data generation means 10C for successively generating variable data by using the obtained data; and a variable data transmission means 10F for successively transmitting the variable data to a printer 3.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Photofinishing system
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a customer to easily and surely obtain convenience being equal to network photo service by printing the retrieval ID information of a prescribed recording medium for image data on the prescribed recording medium according to a prescribed forth and outputting it. SOLUTION: A print 6 is produced at a simultaneous printing time and an order print 9 is produced by printing the retrieval ID information used when the print is ordered on a prescribed paper and outputting it. The customer orders the print by writing necessary matters such as the number of printing sheets on the sheet 9 and giving it to an operator or sending it to a photo studio from his/her home by a facsimile equipment. By the photo studio receiving the order, the information of the order is inputted to an image server 3 by using an order information input means 5. By the server 3, photographic image data specified based on the retrieval ID information inputted from the input means 5 is retrieved from the stored photographic image data and outputted as the print by a printer 4.

docs.title: Image processor
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image processor with which the kind of printing or the position of printing is not limited in the case of printing the completion of processing or serial numbers onto originals. SOLUTION: Original information read by an original input part 1 is temporarily stored in an image; memory part 20. A processor part 22 sends one part of data stored in the image memory part 20 to an image output part 2, prints them on this original information and executes instructed processing. Since this printing is performed by processing at the processor part 22, the kind or position of printing is not limited. Besides, it can be discriminated from the result of printing onto the original information whether the original information is properly read and recognized or not. In this vase, a predetermined image is printed on this original so as to easily recognize the correspondence between the original information and the output of the processing result or the result calculated based on the recognized result of original information is printed on this original.

docs.title: Device, system and program for document management
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a document management device, a document management system and a document management program for which printing is performed with the same print parameter as that applied when a form is printed, even when a print source document is acquired from the page ID of a scanned form and printed.  <P>SOLUTION: An electronic document to be printed is stored in an electronic document storage section 22, and metadata such as a paper document or the like output from an image processor 10 is stored in a metadata storage section 21. When a reproduction instruction of the paper document is carried out by the image processor 10, a print parameter used for printing the paper document is acquired from the metadata storage section 21, and printing is carried out on the basis of the print parameter.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Printing system, printer, print data generating device and program for generating print data
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make the degree of security high in a printing system in which a print data generating device and a printer are connected through a network. SOLUTION: A client PC 10 for generating print data generates a control program for controlling a printing operation in the printer 40, associates the generated control program with pregenerated print contents and outputs the control program associated with the pregenerated print contents as print data. The printer 40 separates the print data acquired from a print data generating device between the control program and the print contents and prints the separated print contents while controlling a printing operation according to the separated and extracted control program. Since the client PC 10 side can freely set a security mechanism by thinking out a control program, the degree of security can be made higher than that of a simple authentication number.

docs.title: Printing system, print control unit, and print control program
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To select a printer intended by a user.  <P>SOLUTION: When receiving a print job from a client terminal 30, a printer decision part 253 in a print server 20 selects a printer 30 based on the print job and print refusal information stored in a print refusal information management table 232. A printer confirmation control part 254 performs processing to make the user of the client terminal 10 of the transmission source of the print job confirm whether to permit printing by the selected printer 30, and when it is decided that it is confirmed that printing is refused based on the confirmation result to be responded and transmitted from the client terminal 10, a print refusal information management part 256 updates the print refusal information of the pertinent printer 30 in a print denial information management table 232.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Photographic print assortment apparatus, method and system, and digital still camera
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a photographic print to be simply send to a designated destination.  <P>SOLUTION: The delivery address data of the photographic print 13 is registered together with image data as ancillary information on a memory card 23. A photographic printer 16 reads the delivery destination data from the memory card 23 and writes the data to a radio tag 46 embedded into the photographic print 13 printed with the image. A sorter 17 reads the delivery address data from the radio tag 46 and assorts the photographic prints 13 by each of the delivery destinations. The photographic prints 13 rearranged by each delivery destination are packed and delivered. Therefore a user placing an order on the print is able to send the photographic print 13 without carrying out delivery work by himself or herself.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a photosensitive material used for infrared exposure, small in change of sensitivity and fog due to storage and enhanceable in processing speed by incorporating a specified compound having a >=95mol% silver chloride content in a silver halide emulsion and regulating the water content of the photosensitive material in the range of 3 - 10wt.%. CONSTITUTION:The silver halide color photographic sensitive material has 3 kinds of silver halide photosensitive layers different from each other in spectrally sensitizing wavelength region on a support, and at least one of the photosensitive layers contains in the silver halide emulsion the >=95mol% silver chloride and one of the compounds represented by formula I in which Z<11> is a nonmetallic atomic group necessary to form a 5- or 6-membered N-containing hetero ring; R<11> is H, alkyl, or alkenyl; R<12> is H or lower alkyl; and X<11> is an acid anion. The photosensitive material is regulated to the water content range of 3 - 10wt.%, thus permitting the obtained photosensitive material to be sensitized in the infrared region and superior in storage stability and easily and rapidly processable.

docs.title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the silver halide color photographic sensitive material superior in color developing performance and fastness of a color image and improved in color reproduction performance by making it contain a specified compound, CONSTITUTION:The silver halide color photographic sensitive material has on a support at least one silver halide emulsion layer and it is characterized by containing at least one kind f cyan coupler represented by the formula and in at least one of the silver halide emulsion layers, negative latent image type silver halide grains chemically sensitized from the surface of each grain to the depth of <=0.02mmu. In formula, R<1> is H or a substituent: R<2> is a substituent: X is H or a group to be released by coupling with the oxidation product of a color developing agent; and Z<1> is a nonmetallic atomic group necessary to form an N-containing 6-membered hetero ring.

docs.title: Color-forming aminopyrimidine couplers and silver halide color photographic light-sensitive materials containing the coupler
docs.abstract:
A color-forming aminopyrimidine coupler represented by formula (I): ##STR1## where R 1 , R 2 , and R 3  independently represent a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, an alkoxy group, an aryloxy group, a heterocyclic-oxy group, an alkylthio group, an arylthio group, a heterocyclic-thio group, a substituted or unsubstitued amino group, a heterocyclic group bonding to the pyrimidine ring via a nitrogen atom thereof, an alkyl group or an aryl group; provided that at least one of R 1 , R 2  and R 3  is an unsubstituted or substituted amino group, and that when any one of R 1 , R 2  or R 3  contains a sulfonic acid group or a salt thereof, R 1  , R 2  or R 3  contains at least one linear or branched alkyl group and that the total carbon atoms in the alkyl group(s) are to be more than 8; and R 4  represents a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, an alkoxy group, an aryloxy group, a heterocyclic-oxy group, an alkylthio group, an arylthio group, a heterocyclic-thio group, a substituted or unsubstituted amino group, or a heterocyclic group bonding to the pyrimidine ring via a nitrogen atom thereof. 
     At least one coupler of formula (I) is incorporated into the photographic constitutive layer of a color silver halide photographic material, which gives a color image with high heat-fastness.

docs.title: Silver halide color reversal photographic sensitive material for photographing
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the silver halide color reversal photographic sensitive material for photographing superior in color reproduction performance, especially, reproduction of colors reflecting light longer in wavelength than 650nm like purple, red, bluish purple, and deep green, and superior in the color saturation of red reproduction. CONSTITUTION:This photosensitive material has a blue-sensitive silver halide emulsion layer containing an yellow coupler, a green-sensitive silver halide emulsion layer containing a magenta coupler, and a red-sensitive silver halide emulsion layer containing a cyan coupler. The maximum sensitivity wavelength lambdaRmax of the red-sensitive emulsion layer, its sensitivity SRmax, and its sensitivity of SR660 at 660nm is characterized by satisfying the following conditions: 630 nm<=lambdaRmax<=650nm, and 0.005SRmax<=SR660<=0.2SRmax.

docs.title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the photosensitive material which is high in desilvering rate and has the adaptability to rapid processing by incorporating fine silver halide particles which have <0.15mum average size and contain the silver chloride adsorbed with a compd. forming the silver salt having the harder solubility than silver bromide at >=50mol% and incorporating at least one kind of compds. which release a bleach accelerating compd. CONSTITUTION:The silver halide color photographic sensitive material having <0.15mum average size and at least >=1 layers of silver halide emulsion layers on a base contains the silver chloride adsorbed with the compd. forming the silver salt having the harder solubility than silver bromide at >=50mol% and contains at least one kind of the compds. which release the bleach accelerating compd. Further the superfine particles have preferably <0.13mum average size, more particularly preferably <0.1mum. The high desilvering rate and the adaptability to the rapid processing is obtd. in this way.

docs.title: Silver halide photographic sensitive material
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To change the color tone of a silver image to a warm tone, without deteriorating the sensitivity of the titled material by incorporating at least one of specified compds. in an emulsion layer or its adjacent layer. CONSTITUTION:At least one of the compds. shown by the formula is incorporated in the emulsion layer or its adjacent layer, PWR may be a group which contains an electron receiving center and an intramolecular nucleophilic substituting reaction center in the compd. capable of releasing a photographic reagent by the intramolecular nucleophilic substituting reaction after reducing said compd. And, PWR may be a group which contains an electron receiving quinonoid center and a carbon atom bonding said center and the photographic reagent in the compd. capable of releasing the photographic reagent by the intramolecular electron transfer reaction after reducing said compd. Thus, the color tone can be changed to the warm tone, without deteriorating the sensitivity of the titled material.
